2026 年第二屆舊好藝術節《左營有光》將於 12 月 12 日在高雄左營登場，官方粉專「舊好生活」今（26）日預告將首度與 VTuber 經紀公司 hololive production 合作，邀請一位對藝術與傳統文化充滿熱情的神祕夥伴，共同介紹左營的百年古厝、傳統工藝與在地故事。

2026 年第二屆舊好藝術節《左營有光》將於 12 月 12 日在高雄左營登場，官方粉專「舊好生活」今（26）日預告將首度與 VTuber 經紀公司 hololive production 合作，邀請一位對藝術與傳統文化充滿熱情的神祕夥伴，共同介紹左營的百年古厝、傳統工藝與在地故事。

 

官方目前尚未公開合作人選，僅釋出剪影供粉絲猜測，其中曾與台南市美術館合作的 hololive DEV_IS 成員儒烏風亭螺鈿成為呼聲極高的可能人選，網友在貼文下方與小編的互動令可信度驟增。

 

 

 

 在 Threads 查看 

 

 

舊好生活表示與 hololive 的合作籌備已久，主辦希望透過不同視角讓更多人認識左營知名景點以外，藏在老房子、傳統工藝與日常生活中的地方故事，至於神祕合作夥伴的真實身分將在後續貼文正式揭曉。

hololive 與台灣地方政府及公共文化機構的合作並非首次，2024 年「台灣燈會在台南」期間就在高鐵燈區的大台南會展中心推出多位 VTuber 花燈、為期兩週的主題快閃店，2026 年高雄市輪船公司也與 hololive 合作邀請白上吹雪與大神澪推出「白狐 × 黑狼紀念系列」主題渡輪。

此外，iPASS 一卡通與 hololive 合作推出聯名交通卡後也曾前往 hololive SUPER EXPO 2024 設攤，於現場宣傳交通部觀光署的「遊台灣金福氣」旅遊補助方案，希望吸引日本粉絲來台旅遊。

而儒烏風亭螺鈿數度與台灣品牌合作，案例包括 2024 年 10 月與噶瑪蘭威士忌跨界聯名，並在她的家鄉福岡展開實體推廣活動；同年 11 月更受台南市美術館之邀直播介紹館內建築、藝術展覽與台南美食；2026 年 6 月與大英博物館合作周邊首站在南港展出；7 月與霹靂布袋戲《東離劍遊紀》聯動橫跨台日兩地展出。

articles.title: Pliant Wins FCA EMI Licence to Serve UK B2B Payments Market Directly
articles.excerpt:
The Berlin-based B2B payments platform can now issue payment products in the UK through its own regulated entity, Pliant Payments Limited.

The post Pliant Wins FCA EMI Licence to Serve UK B2B Payments Market Directly appeared first on The Fintech Times .

Pliant , the Berlin-headquartered modular B2B payments platform, has received full authorisation from the Financial Conduct Authority as an Electronic Money Institution, granting its UK subsidiary, Pliant Payments Limited , the standing to issue payment products and serve customers directly under a locally regulated entity. The authorisation was announced on 14 October 2026. 

 Malte Rau, CEO and co-founder of Pliant 

The milestone closes a structural gap in Pliant’s UK market position. The company had previously operated in the UK through its Finnish subsidiary, a common bridging arrangement among European fintechs that hold an EU e-money licence but have not yet secured a post-Brexit UK authorisation of their own. That arrangement provides market access but limits commercial independence: contractual relationships, safeguarding obligations and product structuring are all routed through an entity incorporated in a different jurisdiction, which can slow product iteration and add friction for regulated UK counterparties such as banks and public-sector bodies.

 Malte Rau , chief executive and co-founder of Pliant, said: “This authorisation gives us greater independence and flexibility to serve UK customers directly. It also puts us in a stronger position to bring our technology to more businesses, financial institutions and public-sector organisations as we continue to expand our capabilities and reach.”

 What the licence unlocks 

As an authorised EMI, Pliant Payments Limited can issue e-money, hold client funds under the FCA’s safeguarding regime, and build payment programmes for corporate customers without relying on a third-party licensed entity in the UK. For a platform that positions itself as infrastructure for fintechs, software platforms and banks building their own commercial card and payment offerings, holding a UK licence is a commercial pre-condition rather than a regulatory nicety. Regulated financial institutions conducting due diligence on a vendor typically require the vendor to carry its own local licence rather than passport from elsewhere.

Pliant’s broader product stack covers commercial card issuing, payment accounts, foreign exchange and spend management. The company is a principal member of both Visa and Mastercard and currently issues commercial cards in 13 currencies across 32 countries. It also positions its API-first infrastructure as compatible with AI agent use cases, with permissions and auditability built in at the platform level.

 Regulatory and competitive context 

The FCA’s EMI authorisation process has become more demanding since the UK diverged from EU payments regulation after Brexit. Applicants face scrutiny of customer onboarding procedures, risk management frameworks, safeguarding arrangements and financial controls, a process Pliant described as extensive. The pace of approvals has also been a constraint for the market: several European fintechs have waited considerably longer than expected for UK licences, creating a bottleneck that has shaped how the sector structures its UK go-to-market strategies.

Pliant now sits alongside a growing cohort of European B2B payments and commercial card providers that have secured their own FCA EMI status, including firms competing in the corporate spend management and banking-as-a-service segments. The UK commercial payments market continues to attract entrants given the scale of business card spend and the fragmentation of legacy corporate banking infrastructure, but the segment is increasingly crowded. Pliant’s differentiation case rests on its modular, API-first architecture and its stated capacity to support complex, multi-currency payment workflows for enterprise and AI-native technology clients.

The next indicators to watch will be the pace of new UK client signings, any expansion of the public-sector partnerships referenced in the announcement, and whether Pliant pursues additional UK regulatory permissions beyond the base EMI authorisation.

The post Pliant Wins FCA EMI Licence to Serve UK B2B Payments Market Directly appeared first on The Fintech Times .

articles.title: 比特幣為什麼有時像黃金、有時像科技股？把美元、美債、美股、黃金、石油、比特幣一次串起來看
articles.excerpt:
美元、美債、美股、黃金、石油與比特幣分屬六個市場，卻常透過利率與美元強弱連動。搞懂這條樞紐，比死背即時報價更能 […]

〈 比特幣為什麼有時像黃金、有時像科技股？把美元、美債、美股、黃金、石油、比特幣一次串起來看 〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《 動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體 》。

美元、美債、美股、黃金、石油與比特幣分屬六個市場，卻常透過利率與美元強弱連動。搞懂這條樞紐，比死背即時報價更能看清資金怎麼搬家，也更能判斷加密市場何時偏避險敘事、何時更像風險資產。 （前情提要：費半重摔 6.7%，美債殖利率終於跌破 5%，但這可能不是好事） （背景補充：美元走強不該怕！資料顯示比特幣與美元指數關聯只剩 17%） 夜市收攤後滑盤，螢幕上同時跳出美元指數、十年期美債殖利率、那斯達克、金價、油價與比特幣，六條線各走各的，讀起來像六本百科。不過若把問題收窄成「錢貴不貴、美元強不強、大家敢不敢冒險」，這六樣資產其實常在同一張因果圖上移動。 這篇不預測漲跌，只把機制講清楚：美元與美債怎麼定價資金成本，利率與美元如何牽動美股、黃金、石油，以及比特幣為什麼有時像黃金、有時又像科技股。 美元跟美債，誰在定「資金的價錢」？ 先講美元。它不只是美國人的鈔票，更是全球貿易、商品計價與官方儲備裡最常見的單位。依國際貨幣基金（IMF）COFER長期追蹤，美元仍是全球外匯儲備中占比最高的貨幣；美元一緊，跨國流動性常一起變緊。 市場觀測美元強弱，常看 ICE 美元指數（俗稱 DXY）：它用歐元、日圓、英鎊、加幣、瑞典克朗與瑞士法郎等六種貨幣，對美元做加權幾何平均，指數升＝美元相對這一籃子走強。 再講美債。依美國財政部 TreasuryDirect 說明，公債是投資人把錢借給聯邦政府的可轉讓證券；短天期叫國庫券（bills）、中長天期叫公債票據與公債（notes／bonds）。換言之，美債本質就是一張國家級借據。 價格與殖利率反向：殖利率上升，通常代表既有債券變便宜；財政部也寫得很直白 —— 到期殖利率高於票面利率時，價格會低於面額。短端更貼近聯準會（Fed）政策利率，長端摻進成長與通膨預期；聯準會對名目殖利率曲線的說明也指出，美債報酬常被實務當成「無風險」基準。 利率動了，美股、黃金、石油為什麼會一起抖？ 美股是風險資產。公司未來現金流要折現成今天的股價，折現率裡就有利率；利率升、資金成本升，同等獲利預期下的估值壓力變大。反觀風險偏好升溫時，資金常從債與現金往股市移動，所以「降息預期」與「科技股反彈」經常同框。 黃金不發利息，持有的機會成本就是實質利率。世界黃金協會（WGC）把利率變動視為金價短線驅動之一：利率升、持金相對變貴，金價常承壓。不過它也提醒這不是永遠鐵律 —— 通膨、美元強弱與地緣都可能蓋過利率效果。 美元計價也會下手：美元走強時，非美買家用本幣買同一盎司黃金或同一桶石油變貴，報價常一起受壓；這是歷史常見反向，不是保證明年仍成立的定律。實體面再看央行，依 WGC 2025 全年需求趨勢，全球央行與相關機構淨購金約 863 公噸，雖低於前幾年逾千公噸，仍高於 2010–2021 年平均。 石油是實體大宗＋地緣敏感品。美國能源資訊署（EIA）說明，地緣與供給中斷預期會透過風險溢價推高油價波動；油價升、通膨預期熱，再回饋利率定價。另有「石油美元」脈絡：IMF 史料寫到 1970 年代產油國累積大量美元收入（petrodollars）；BIS 也指出，主要產油國長期以美元計價結算，收入再回流美債等資產，強化美元地位。 比特幣比較像黃金，還是比較像科技股？ 機制上，比特幣供給有硬上限。新幣依固定節奏發行，最終流通上限約 2,100 萬枚；敘事上常被拿來跟「不能無限印」的黃金類比，稱作數位黃金。 不過看交易行為，它又常跟風險資產同向：流動性寬鬆、科技股風險偏好升時一起漲；風險厭惡升溫、美股急殺時也常一起跌。反觀跟美元指數的關係，也不該想成永遠鎖死的反向。 動區舊文引述的資料曾指出，比特幣報酬裡能被美元指數解釋的比例可低到約 17%，顯示單看 DXY 往往不夠。換言之，讀比特幣要並陳兩面：供給故事像黃金，資金行為常像高 Beta 風險資產。 讀宏觀時，先把哪幾條因果鏈對上？ 可以先記一張白話地圖。利率升 → 折現率與資金成本升 → 美債價格承壓、美股估值壓力變大；利率預期若翻轉向下，路徑大致相反。美元走強 → 以美元計價的黃金、石油常相對承壓；美元走弱則常給較鬆的報價環境。 再看情緒與通膨。風險偏好高 → 資金更願意進美股與比特幣；風險偏好崩 → 兩者常一起失血。通膨或地緣升溫 → 油價與金價可能先動，通膨預期再影響長端殖利率，最後繞回股債定價。對加密市場來說，真正要盯的往往是「Fed 路徑、美元流動性、風險情緒」有沒有同時轉向。 現在能確認的是：美元是計價與儲備樞紐，美債是無風險利率錨，美股吃折現與獲利雙邊，黃金是非孳息避險／儲備金屬，石油是通膨傳遞帶，比特幣同時掛著稀缺敘事與風險資產行為。下一步優先對：Fed 路徑與實質利率、DXY、長端美債殖利率、油價是否改寫通膨預期，以及比特幣當下是跟金還是跟那斯達克站同一邊。 相關報導 美股血洗！那斯達克重挫 2%、晶片股暴跌 5%，比特幣跌破 8.2 萬美元 布倫特原油收 113 美元創半年新高，美以傳選後「短期密集」再打伊朗 預測市場不只賭體育！Robinhood 執行長：比特幣、黃金合約成長最快 articles.title: 開局只有一把牙刷 16人月球清潔公司《Moon Sweepers》Steam同接突破3.6萬
articles.excerpt:
兩人開發團隊 DragDrop Games 推出的合作清潔模擬遊戲《Moon Sweepers》於 10 月 23 日在 Steam 新品節的尾聲上市，主打自動化玩法並支援最多 16 人同遊，起步卻只有一把牙刷引熱議，三天內在第一個周末同上玩家突破 3.6 萬峰值。

兩人開發團隊 DragDrop Games 推出的合作清潔模擬遊戲《Moon Sweepers》於 10 月 23 日在 Steam 新品節的尾聲上市，主打自動化玩法並支援最多 16 人同遊，起步卻只有一把牙刷引熱議，三天內在第一個周末同上玩家突破 3.6 萬峰值。

 

 

 

《Moon Sweepers》提供繁體中文介面，舞台位在布滿灰塵的月球表面，玩家接獲月球表面管理局（Lunar Surface Department，簡稱 LSD）的清掃任務，卻因預算不足，跟監獄一樣只發一支牙刷作為起始工具。

 

但就像愚公移山，一點一點刷除月塵終能成事，蒐集到的灰塵接著要運往收集站，再發射至太空換取報酬，利用收入買更有效率的清潔工具、擴充攜帶容量，逐步改善工作效率。

 

 

 

本作支援單人遊玩，也能與好友組成最多 16 人的線上小隊，多人合作可以分頭清掃不同區域，也能合力處理同一片地面，隨著清掃範圍逐漸擴大，再添購手推式清潔機具及大型清潔車輛。清掃過的地面會呈現不同顏色，方便玩家辨識已完成的區域，逐步推進整個月球的清潔進度。

 

 

 

 

除了升級清掃工具，本作也加入基地建設及自動化系統，建造車庫、輸送帶和太陽能板等設施，還能利用加工設備將月塵製成砂，再將砂與月塵加工成石材以更高價格出售。

 

透過設置輸送帶、分流器及合流器，可以串聯資源運輸、加工與交貨流程，設備完善後可導入自動清潔機器人，原本仰賴人力的清掃工作交給機器處理，從一把牙刷起步的任務逐漸發展成大型清潔事業。

 

 

 

 

DragDrop Games 於 10 月 24 日公告感謝玩家支持，同時為上市初期未盡理想的遊戲體驗致歉，因為目前只有兩名開發成員，正持續整理玩家回報並推出修正更新。

 

已實施的改善包含多人遊戲的升級由整個隊伍共享、提升 Windows 版效能、修復部分無法載入的存檔並加強存檔保護、加入房主踢除及封鎖玩家的功能，改善生產系統的運作。

 

 

 

《Moon Sweepers》已在 Steam 推出，支援機翻繁中介面，上市紀念特價 -15％ 截至 10 月 31 日止。

資安獎金獵人逆向自家 2025 年三星智慧電視，聲稱機上 AI 會蒐集音訊與螢幕截圖供廣告投放，還能分類狗叫與 […]

〈 獎金獵人逆向自家三星電視：客廳 AI 收音截圖做廣告，自己還被 OpenAI 停權 〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《 動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體 》。

資安獎金獵人逆向自家 2025 年三星智慧電視，聲稱機上 AI 會蒐集音訊與螢幕截圖供廣告投放，還能分類狗叫與嬰兒哭聲；他隨後遭 OpenAI 以「cyber abuse」停權。完整技術報告還沒公開，三星與 OpenAI 截至發稿都沒公開回應此個案。 （前情提要：電競耶穌踢爆 LG 智慧電視會錄音偷聽，關螢幕、拔網路也沒用） （背景補充：家中咖啡機 10 天送出 1TB 塞爆 Wi-Fi：沒人知道它在傳什麼） 廣告精準到怪，於是自己拆電視。逆向工程師暨獎金獵人 @log4j 在台北時間 10 月 22 日凌晨連發貼文，說他對自家相對新款的 2025 年三星電視取得 root shell 後，發現一堆隱私相關異常：韌體被 AES 加密難拆，只好用 zero-day 進去；完整 write-up 他說還在寫。 不過這整串目前仍是他的單方說法。台北時間 10 月 25 日，Tom’s Hardware 整理了這些貼文；同期 Hugging Face 工程師 ngxson 用 Flipper Zero 測到麥克風開約 5 秒就停，但那台已 root、多項設定關著，沒改機的行為可能不一樣。 客廳裡的 AI 在幹嘛？音訊、截圖、AID 先看他怎麼講機制。台北時間 10 月 24 日前後，他寫道：電視用自家硬體做後處理，遙測涵蓋音訊、螢幕截圖，以及跨裝置廣告追蹤 ID（AID）；電腦視覺與模型就在電視端側跑，不是整包丟上雲端再算。 換句話說，客廳這台螢幕被他畫成一台「邊看邊分析」的端側節點。同日他另點名區域專用卷積神經網路（CNN），稱會追蹤 App 內行為：在 YouTube 看什麼、跳過哪些廣告、播放進度到哪。 再看沒內建麥克風的機型。他稱系統會去找已連線的 soundbar 或藍牙裝置麥克風，再把音訊送往 Bixby。也就是說，爭議不只「電視有沒有麥」，還包括客廳外接收音路徑會不會被借走。 關了 ACR 就停了嗎？ 很多人會先想到關自動內容辨識（ACR）。可他在台北時間 10 月 25 日晚間提醒：選單關掉 ACR，不該直接假設遙測也停了；他說有些檢查實作不正確、甚至根本沒檢查，完整報告還在準備，也請記者別只靠他的反組譯片段過度推論。 這句但書很重要。計數器或程式碼路徑存在，不等於已經向用戶彈通知，也不等於整段錄音都外傳；生命週期細節他自己也說還沒追完。現在能確認的是「他主張選單開關不可盡信」，還沒確認的是「每一台未改機三星電視實際送出什麼」。 狗叫、嬰兒哭：官方照護 vs 研究者質疑 他另指出電視會分類聽見的音訊再回報三星；遙測脈絡裡出現偏好設定、狗叫與嬰兒哭事件計數器等。爭議焦點比較像「回報與廣告追蹤是否透明」，而不是「能不能偵測狗叫」這件事本身。 反觀三星官方敘事，Vision AI、SmartThings Pet Care 與 Family Care 本來就講過：可用麥克風偵測狗叫、嬰兒哭並通知，需在 SmartThings 啟用，部分高階機型才支援聲音感測。 兩條線最好分開看：官方強調寵物與家庭照護；研究者質疑同意範圍、透明度與廣告資料蒐集。另有貼文提到人臉框選程式碼，目前證據只到「框出臉部範圍」，還推不到「辨識你是誰」。 逆向研究撞上 OpenAI 的 Cyber Abuse 同一波爭議的另一頭，是 AI 平台怎麼處置研究者。@log4j 於台北時間 10 月 23 日晚間貼文稱因逆向工程被 ban，損失約 500 美元與 banked resets，並附上標示 Cyber Abuse 的郵件截圖。 他的說法是：從未用 OpenAI 找漏洞或發動攻擊，只做本機逆向，卻觸發 Daybreak。OpenAI 截至發稿尚未公開評論此停權個案；三星也還沒就他的具體指控公開回應。 現在能確認的是：一連串貼文把「客廳端側 AI＋廣告遙測」推上檯面，媒體已跟進，但完整 write-up 還沒公開。下一步就看報告細節、官方要不要回應，以及未改機機型上的行為能不能被獨立複現。 相關報導 電競耶穌踢爆 LG 智慧電視會錄音偷聽，關螢幕、拔網路也沒用 家中咖啡機 10 天送出 1TB 塞爆 Wi-Fi：沒人知道它在傳什麼 三星霸王條款：個人健康資料提供 AI 訓練，不同意就把你睡眠、經期紀錄刪光 中國智慧洗衣機被爆「19 小時流量 411MB 」：官方稱要查〈獎金獵人逆向自家三星電視：客廳 AI 收音截圖做廣告，自己還被 OpenAI 停權〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。

articles.title: 台北飛東京空難推理《UNKNOWN PASSENGER 47》Steam亮相 47人罹難卻有48具遺體
articles.excerpt:
日本單人開發者 OrangeLily 工作室 LilyCompany 打造的文字推理遊戲《UNKNOWN PASSENGER 47》即日在 Steam 上架，預定近期推出並提供繁體中文介面。目前玩家已可透過 itch.io 免費試玩日文版 demo。

日本單人開發者 OrangeLily 工作室 LilyCompany 打造的文字推理遊戲《UNKNOWN PASSENGER 47》即日在 Steam 上架，預定近期推出並提供繁體中文介面。目前玩家已可透過 itch.io 免費試玩日文版 demo。

 

本作玩法類似死因推理名作《奧伯拉丁的回歸》，主題從 19 世紀初的船難，變成現代人熟悉的台北飛往東京客機空難，玩家必須調查 48 具遺體的紀錄，釐清乘客與機組員的身分，解開明明只有 47 人罹難，卻發現 48 具遺體的謎團。

 

 

▼ 『あなたの個人情報は見られています』のプレイはこちらから unityroom: https://t.co/Cb0PvVKFId itchio: https://t.co/6mPXm93mez

— おれんじりりぃ@りりぃカンパニー (@orange_lily1127) October 21, 2026 

 

遊戲裡的虛構「蒼天航空」SA417 航班從台北飛往東京途中墜毀，機上 40 名乘客與 7 名機組員全數罹難，意外的是，搜救與善後的團隊最後在事故現場回收了 48 具遺體。

 

多出的遺體究竟是哪一具？玩家將扮演身分確認人員，頂著對死者的尊重與還原災難事後還原的沉重感，從只有編號的遺體紀錄、搭機者名單及其他調查資料著手，替每一名死者找回姓名。

 

 

 

調查過程中提供自動儲存功能。玩家能查閱包含遺體特徵、推定年齡、牙科檢查結果、手術疤痕、衣物與隨身物品等資訊，再與乘客名單、醫療查詢、住宿紀錄、機上銷售明細等 17 類輔助資料交叉比對。

 

單憑一項線索可能無法確認身分，但只要找出不同紀錄之間的關聯，就能逐漸縮小範圍，推導出正確的身分配對。

 

 

 

為了方便玩家整理線索，遊戲設有專屬工作桌，可將不同資料卡片自由移動並排比較，還能新增便利貼記錄推理過程；玩家能平移與縮放調整工作區域，把推導出的乘客或機組員編號配對遺體編號記錄為暫定結果，每累積 3 組正確配對，系統便會一併確認身分。

 

 

 

開發者介紹，本作預估遊玩時間約為 2 至 3 小時，沒有時間限制，也不會因為推理錯誤而直接結束，每具遺體都設有 3 階段提示，讓玩家在卡關時逐步獲得協助，必要時也能進一步確認答案。

 

 

 

《UNKNOWN PASSENGER 47》已於 9 月 26 日在 unityroom 與 itch.io 免費公開，但目前試玩版僅支援日文，官方提醒故事的內容純屬虛構，與真實人物、組織或事故無關，遊戲中的空難、死亡、遺體損傷及醫療檢查結果僅限文字描述，不會呈現遺體影像。

articles.title: 以太坊基金會關聯地址再出貨！鏈上賣 2,785 枚 ETH 換 642 萬美元 USDS
articles.excerpt:
以太坊基金會關聯地址據稱透過 CoW Swap 賣出 2,785 枚 ETH，換得約 642 萬美元等值 US […]

〈 以太坊基金會關聯地址再出貨！鏈上賣 2,785 枚 ETH 換 642 萬美元 USDS 〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《 動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體 》。

以太坊基金會關聯地址據稱透過 CoW Swap 賣出 2,785 枚 ETH，換得約 642 萬美元等值 USDS，均價約 2,304 美元。基金會尚未官方確認該地址歸屬與資金用途。 （前情提要：以太坊基金會又賣幣？補助金錢包轉出 566 枚 ETH，小額流入 Upbit 關聯地址） （背景補充：以太坊基金會大轉型：Vitalik 發布 CROPS 框架、縮小規模，拒絕再當ETH砸盤方） 台北時間 10 月 26 日上午，鏈上監測指出地址 0x5CBC…2059 透過 CoW Protocol 的 CoW Swap Eth Flow 連續建立多筆賣單。多家鏈上分析師將其認定為「基金會關聯地址」，合計拋售約 2,785 枚 ETH，短時間內引發社群關注，並與近期「基金會是否又在賣幣」敘事疊加。 據 Onchain Lens 與 Lookonchain 監測，這批 ETH 換得約 642 萬美元等值 USDS（Sky／原 MakerDAO 穩定幣），成交均價約 2,304 美元。以太坊基金會截至發稿尚未公開確認該地址現時歸屬與賣幣目的。 上午密集掛單，換得 USDS 並部分轉存 sUSDS 交易集中在台北時間約 10 時 15 分至 11 時 09 分（UTC 02:15–03:09）。對 CoW Swap Eth Flow 發出的 Create Order 規模約為 185、500、600、1,000、500 枚 ETH，加總 2,785 枚，屬分批出貨而非單筆砸盤。 選擇批次撮合協定而非單一流動性池，常見於希望降低滑價、並把大額賣壓拆成多筆掛單的調度。此次成交標的為 USDS，而非直接換入法幣通道，路徑偏鏈上穩定幣。 Etherscan 顯示，該地址賣出後仍約餘 15,000 枚 ETH。鏈上亦可見換得之 USDS 已部分或大量存成 sUSDS（Savings USDS），實際營運用途仍待官方說明。 Ai 姨（@ai_9684xtpa）同步指出，此為該關聯地址繼 10 月 12 日相關動向後的又一次拋售觀察。 兩週前關聯錢包曾向 Kraken 儲值 4,393 ETH 回顧前情，台北時間 10 月 12 日前後，Lookonchain 監測兩個基金會關聯錢包向 Kraken 合計儲值 4,393 枚 ETH，約合 1,113 萬美元，當時均價約 2,534 美元。 對照本次經 CoW Swap 直接換穩定幣，路徑不同，但同樣觸動「基金會是否又在調庫」的討論。 Lookonchain 本次亦提到，自兩週前疑似賣壓觀察以來，ETH 約跌 9%。截至發稿時（台北時間 10 月 26 日約 14:45），CoinGecko 顯示 ETH 約 2,315 美元，近 24 小時約跌 1.3%。 相關報導 以太坊基金會又賣幣？補助金錢包轉出 566 枚 ETH，小額流入 Upbit 關聯地址 以太坊基金會大轉型：Vitalik 發布 CROPS 框架、縮小規模，拒絕再當ETH砸盤方 以太坊基金會解質押 4,890 萬美元 ETH，前天剛 OTC 賣一萬枚 ETH 以太坊基金會不賣幣了！啟動首次質押「7 萬枚 ETH 轉移信標鏈」，收益全面支持開發生態〈以太坊基金會關聯地址再出貨！鏈上賣 2,785 枚 ETH 換 642 萬美元 USDS〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。

跨鏈 Telegram 交易機器人 BloomTrading 爆發錢包被盜爭議：官方稱辨識 9 名受影響用戶並 […]

〈 BloomTrading 用戶錢包被盜！官方認 9 人將全額賠，鏈上監測指約 49 錢包近百萬美元受害 〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《 動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體 》。

跨鏈 Telegram 交易機器人 BloomTrading 爆發錢包被盜爭議：官方稱辨識 9 名受影響用戶並承諾全額賠償至新安全錢包；鏈上監測則指約 49 個錢包遭掃走約 9,408 SOL、近 95 萬美元，根因尚未證實。 （前情提要：CZ：沒有錢包 100% 安全！PHP 漏洞、Railway 遭駭接連爆發，幣安急表態） （背景補充：硬體錢包廠 Keystone 資安承諾翻車！180 天刪資料形同虛設，2 年前訂單個資遭外洩） 跨鏈交易自動化平台 BloomTrading（主打 SOL｜EVM 的 Telegram 交易機器人）於台北時間 10 月 26 日陷入用戶錢包被掃爭議。官方在 X 回覆稱正在調查、其他錢包仍安全，並出於謹慎暫時停用部分服務，請用戶至 Discord 開 ticket 處理後續。官方後續表示目前辨識出 9 名受影響用戶，承諾全額賠償至用戶指定的新安全錢包，並否認這是跑路或 exit scam。 另據鏈上監測帳號 Onchain Lens，疑似盜幣地址從約 49 名受害者收進約 9,408 SOL，約合 95.4 萬美元，最大單筆約 1,636 SOL。官方「9 人」與鏈上「約 49 錢包」並存，根因尚未獲官方證實。 用戶指控 社交媒體流傳多名用戶指認資產被轉走。用戶 @domyxbt 稱損失約 8 萬美元，並請協助聯絡交易所。 其後該用戶補充，認為約九成五與 Bloom 有關，理由包括其他熱錢包未動、未使用其他同類機器人、僅用過 Bloom。另有一筆鏈上轉帳約 640.45 SOL、約合 6.4 萬美元，流向地址開頭為 7kY8qx… 的帳戶。 官方調查、停服與全額賠償承諾 BloomTrading 在官方串文中否認「跑路」，強調自 2018 年做軟體、不會為錢毀誠信。官方稱不需要救濟基金，將直接把賠償打到用戶指定的新安全錢包。 官方貼文寫道根因仍在查，包含是否第三方供應商遭入侵，並提到近期產業資安潮。另一則貼文重申這不是 exit scam，已承諾全額賠償 9 名受影響用戶。 截至發稿，官方說法為：已辨識 9 人、持續調查所有回報的錢包活動，根因尚未確認，但會全額賠償所有確認受影響用戶。 鏈上監測與媒體彙整：49 錢包 vs 官方 9 人 Onchain Lens 監測指，駭客在其一個疑似 drainer 錢包中，從約 49 名受害者掃走 9,408 SOL，最終數字可能更高；最大單筆約 1,636 SOL、約合 16.6 萬美元，並呼籲用戶斷開連線、轉移資金。 CryptoBriefing 彙整相近數字：約 48 至 49 個錢包、約 9,408 SOL、約 95 至 95.4 萬美元，損失幾乎全是 SOL、部分 USDC 未動，並提到平台為用戶產生私鑰的託管式風險。 託管式機器人風險與產業脈絡 BloomTrading 自我定位為跨鏈交易自動化（SOL｜EVM）的 Telegram 交易機器人。此類產品常代用戶產生或託管私鑰，便利與風險並存；一旦供應商或內部環節出事，用戶熱錢包可能同步承壓。 即便官方承諾全額賠償並暫停部分服務，用戶仍須自行評估權限、熱錢包曝險與資金存放方式。後續關注重點在根因報告、實際到帳賠償，以及鏈上規模是否再擴大。 相關報導 CZ：沒有錢包 100% 安全！PHP 漏洞、Railway 遭駭接連爆發，幣安急表態 硬體錢包廠 Keystone 資安承諾翻車！180 天刪資料形同虛設，2 年前訂單個資遭外洩 安卓手機 45 秒被盜加密錢包助記詞！Ledger 揭露聯發科晶片致命漏洞，全球 25% 設備恐淪陷 MEV策略狂飆讓TG機器人崩盤：以太坊優先費誰在買單？〈BloomTrading 用戶錢包被盜！官方認 9 人將全額賠，鏈上監測指約 49 錢包近百萬美元受害〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。

articles.title: CZ PIVOT 專訪整理：每人可擁有成百上千萬 Agent，加密才是原生支付
articles.excerpt:
幣安創辦人趙長鵬（CZ）接受日本媒體 PIVOT 專訪，談 AI 與區塊鏈合流、日圓穩定幣與代幣化，並稱「今日 […]

〈 CZ PIVOT 專訪整理：每人可擁有成百上千萬 Agent，加密才是原生支付 〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《 動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體 》。

幣安創辦人趙長鵬（CZ）接受日本媒體 PIVOT 專訪，談 AI 與區塊鏈合流、日圓穩定幣與代幣化，並稱「今日是史上最佳創業日」。 （前情提要：紐約時報特稿：走進億萬富翁趙長鵬的生活） （背景補充：幣安支付透過 HIVEX® 開通日本 PayPay 商家支付功能） 幣安（Binance）創辦人趙長鵬（Changpeng Zhao，CZ）近日接受日本媒體 PIVOT GLOBAL 專訪，從阿布達比連線談日本淵源、稅制改革、司法經歷，以及 AI 與加密合流的下一個十年。他隨後在 X 貼文寫道，這場對談圍繞 AI、區塊鏈，以及他為何認定今天是史上最好的建設時刻。 訪談由野嶋紗己子主持，影片約於台北時間 10 月 24 日釋出。以下依英文字幕整理 CZ 核心觀點，聚焦其對產業與日本市場的公開論述。 日本淵源與用戶信任：從東證系統到全球第一 CZ 表示，大學畢業後第一份工作在東京，為東京證券交易所（TSE）開發訂單與撮合系統，當時以 C++ 寫底層記憶體管理，那套經驗後來一路演進到幣安交易所核心。 2017 年 7 月團隊在上海創業，約 6 週後中國禁止加密交易所與 ICO，約 30 人團隊遷往東京目黑。他指出日本當年較早認可比特幣並開放交易所登記，但僅允約 10 至 20 種主流幣，與幣安主打大量山寨幣上市的模式不合，因而暫離；如今 Binance Japan 已持牌，並與 SoftBank 等合作。 創業約 5 個月、約於 2017 年 12 月 17 日，幣安以交易量登上全球第一。CZ 歸功於此前約 17 年交易所系統經驗、ICO 熱潮，以及中國禁令期間自掏約 600 萬美元（約占當時金庫 40%）補償用戶 —— 強調那並非交易所過失，卻強化客服與出金體驗，換來用戶信任。 稅制、日圓穩定幣與資產代幣化 談及日本加密稅由最高約 55% 雜所得調向約 20%（類股票資本利得），CZ 認為此舉相當正面，有望把成交量帶回日本。他觀察日本創業者相對誠實、rug pull 較少，應鼓勵合法以加密募資。 對政府，他歸納兩大課題：一是交易所監管，二是資產代幣化 —— 股債、房地產、稀土、基礎設施等皆可上鏈融資。全球穩定幣約 99% 錨定美元，他呼籲加速日圓穩定幣；並形容日本決策謹慎、一旦拍板執行極快。 AI×加密：Agent 需要原生數位貨幣 CZ 把成年後三大科技歸納為網路、區塊鏈與 AI。他預期未來每人可有成百、上千甚至上百萬個 AI agent 在背景工作，剪輯、發行、行銷與收款都可能交給 agent。 這些 agent 不適合用信用卡或銀行帳戶，理想是使用原生數位貨幣 —— 也就是加密貨幣。他估計交易速度可能提升千至百萬倍，並催生微型支付，例如看一支影片付 1 日圓。時間表約 5 年或更短，瓶頸不在技術，而在人類採用與政府合法化。 Giggle Academy 與給年輕人的話 CZ 說世界不完全公平，但要向前看，從創造財富轉向創造機會。他打造免費教育平台 Giggle Academy：全球約 5 億兒童無法上學、約 7 億成人文盲（約三分之二為女性）；平台今年初約 10 萬學童，現約 200 萬，成長約 20 倍。 年花費約 500 萬美元、團隊約 50 人，無內購；未來畢業生可自願回捐收入一定比例，目標可持續並擴至億級用戶。對年輕人，他鼓勵把握當下立刻動手建設，建議學 AI 與區塊鏈，不推薦終身雇傭「salary man」路徑，創業雖痛但回報與影響力更大。 相關報導 CZ：AI 不需破解比特幣密碼，資料洩露已足以威脅加密資產安全 CZ 自傳《幣安人生》今日上架：364 頁回顧入獄認罪、幣安崩盤，書籍收益全捐慈善 穩定幣也能炒！日圓 JPYC 上架韓國 Upbit，一枚炒到 4 日圓 方舟女股神：當 Agent 開始花錢，投資人須關注 AI 使用什麼基礎設施〈CZ PIVOT 專訪整理：每人可擁有成百上千萬 Agent，加密才是原生支付〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。

articles.title: L2 Capital Picks Newton to Tokenize $500m Pre-IPO AI Shares
articles.excerpt:
The Hong Kong investment firm will use Newton Labs' compliance protocol to put late-stage private technology holdings onchain for eligible investors.

The post L2 Capital Picks Newton to Tokenize $500m Pre-IPO AI Shares appeared first on The Fintech Times .

L2 Capital , a Hong Kong-based technology investment firm, has signed on as a founding partner of Newton Labs ‘ tokenization platform, targeting $500 million in tokenized pre-IPO and late-stage technology holdings within 24 months of the platform’s launch. The partnership is one of the more substantive announced applications of real-world asset tokenization to private-market equity, a segment where operational friction and compliance complexity have historically kept institutional experimentation limited. 

The platform is still under development. L2 Capital plans to onboard selected positions from its own portfolio, as well as opportunities originated with other firms, giving eligible institutional and professional investors the ability to hold those positions onchain and use them as collateral in permitted decentralised finance lending markets.

 The compliance problem Newton is trying to solve 

 Dennis Won, co-founder and chief technology officer at Newton Labs 

The core technical proposition from Newton Labs centres on a problem that has stalled broader adoption of tokenized regulated assets in DeFi contexts. Most existing tokenization approaches enforce compliance at the point of issuance or by restricting which wallets can receive a token. Once a token moves into a lending protocol or secondary application, those controls frequently stop applying, creating regulatory and counterparty risk.

Newton Protocol, which will serve as the platform’s authorisation layer, is designed to check every transfer, loan or other action against the fund manager’s codified policy rules before settlement, regardless of which permitted application the token is operating in. The system records each decision onchain as a signed, verifiable result. The platform is also being designed to support confidential policy enforcement, allowing institutions to apply sensitive requirements without public disclosure, with controlled access for regulators and auditors.

 Dennis Won , co-founder and chief technology officer of Newton Labs, said the goal is to let eligible investors access holdings that have historically been out of reach and borrow against those positions without having to sell. Kevin Lee, co-founder and partner at L2 Capital, framed the partnership as the next step in widening access to private-market value creation: “Investors in our holdings want to know the rules are being followed, not take our word for it.”

 Market context and regulatory read-across 

The pre-IPO secondary market has attracted growing institutional attention, driven in part by extended private-company lifecycles among high-profile AI firms. The structural challenge is that private shares carry layered transfer restrictions, investor eligibility requirements and lock-up conditions, all of which are difficult to automate in the existing manual-review model used by most secondary market intermediaries.

Newton Labs brings notable institutional backing, including PayPal Ventures , Lightspeed Venture Partners , Tiger Global and Digital Currency Group , and a history that includes building more than 60 million embedded wallets before selling that business to Payward Services, Kraken’s parent company, in 2026 to focus on the compliance infrastructure layer.

Regulatory scrutiny of tokenized real-world assets is intensifying across relevant jurisdictions. In the EU, MiCA sets out a framework for asset-referenced tokens but leaves significant ambiguity around private equity instruments. In Hong Kong, the Securities and Futures Commission has been active in licensing digital-asset platforms and has issued guidance on tokenized securities, making it one of the more permissive but also more closely watched markets for this type of structure. The platform’s stated restriction to eligible institutional and professional investors in licensed jurisdictions is consistent with the approach regulators in both markets have indicated they expect.

The $500 million target is framed as a 24-month aspiration rather than a committed figure, and the platform has not yet launched. The markers to watch are the platform’s go-live date, the jurisdictions in which it obtains or relies on existing licences, and whether additional fund managers join L2 Capital as clients.

The post L2 Capital Picks Newton to Tokenize $500m Pre-IPO AI Shares appeared first on The Fintech Times .

articles.title: 印度交易所 CoinDCX 舊錢包遭盜 1,600 萬美元，執行長曾稱誤報
articles.excerpt:
印度交易所 CoinDCX 證實已停用的存款錢包遭攻擊，損失 1,599 萬 USDT 由公司吸收；執行長 Sumit Gupta 先前曾在 X 上稱錢包沒被駭、聽起來是誤報。

這篇文章 印度交易所 CoinDCX 舊錢包遭盜 1,600 萬美元，執行長曾稱誤報 最早出現於 鏈新聞 ABMedia 。

印度加密貨幣交易所 CoinDCX 10 月 25 日在 官方部落格 證實，舊的存款錢包遭攻擊，損失 1,599 萬 USDT（約 1,600 萬美元），由公司吸收。三天前，共同創辦人暨執行長 Sumit Gupta 還在 X 上說錢包沒有被駭，「聽起來是誤報」。

部落格：自動歸集服務失效，用戶存款堆在舊地址

CoinDCX 在部落格說明，異常活動「影響了我們舊的、已停用的錢包基礎設施，其中存在未知漏洞」。交易所用來在錢包之間搬移資金的自動歸集服務「在某段期間失效」，用戶存進舊地址的款項因此累積在交易所已不再使用的地址上，「造成 1,599 萬 USDT 的損失，由公司吸收」。

CoinDCX 強調所有用戶資金仍存放在分離的冷錢包中，一般交易、充值與提領照常運作。對於為什麼隔了幾天才公布，部落格寫道：「全面檢查已停用的基礎設施、確認事件經過花了一些時間。我們本可以更主動，但一掌握完整情況就發布了這份更新。」CoinDCX 也說之後會加強對殘留系統的監控，並定期提醒用戶更新充值地址。

從「別散播謠言」到承認營運損失

最早發現異常的是資產救援服務 FlashRescue 共同創辦人 Darcy。他在 10 月 22 日 發文 指出，10 月 21 日 23:35（台灣時間），CoinDCX 熱錢包和多個充值地址把約 1,599 萬 USDT 與 5,783.81 枚 TRX 轉進同一個 TRON 地址，最大一筆為 15,819,002 USDT，之後被拆分轉往幣安、OKX、Gate 等交易所的充值地址。

不到三小時，Gupta 回覆 ：「謝謝提醒，但這不正確，CoinDCX 錢包沒有被駭，請不要散播謠言。」他說這些地址是 2025 年 1 月產生、在 2025 年 7 月那次駭客事件中就已外洩，「駭客似乎在重複利用舊地址，這聽起來是誤報」。四分鐘後 CoinDCX 官方帳號也 發文 稱相關說法「具誤導性」，這些地址自 2025 年 7 月後就沒再使用。

鏈上偵探 ZachXBT 隨即 反駁 ，指其中一個存款地址在 2025 年 7 月事件後仍由一家流動性提供者使用了 10 個月，最近在 2026 年 4、5 月還把用戶存款歸集到 CoinDCX 現役的熱錢包，「代表有 1,580 萬美元的用戶存款沒被你們的團隊算進去」。

同日稍晚，CoinDCX 改口 發文 ，說仍有用戶把錢存進已停用的地址，而定期歸集這類存款的流程「在某段期間失效」，「造成部分營運損失，由 CoinDCX 吸收」，受影響用戶的存款都已入帳，但沒有寫出金額。ZachXBT 接著 呼籲 用戶把資金全數撤出 CoinDCX，稱共同創辦人公開與私下都否認遭竊，「要不是直接說謊，就是無能到失職」；他也說自己仍協助 CoinDCX 凍結了六位數美元的被盜資產。

CoinDCX 在 2025 年 7 月曾遭駭約 4,400 萬美元， 當時 Gupta 表示 損失同樣由公司吸收。 The Block 向 CoinDCX 的公關公司詢問 Gupta 先前的說法與 ZachXBT 的指控，對方只請記者參考部落格文章，沒有回答具體問題。

這篇文章 印度交易所 CoinDCX 舊錢包遭盜 1,600 萬美元，執行長曾稱誤報 最早出現於 鏈新聞 ABMedia 。

articles.title: Coinbase 比特幣溢價連 33 天負值！美國買盤持續疲軟
articles.excerpt:
Coinbase 比特幣溢價指數連 33 日錄得負值，截至台北時間 10 月 26 日最新報 -0.1259% […]

〈 Coinbase 比特幣溢價連 33 天負值！美國買盤持續疲軟 〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《 動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體 》。

Coinbase 比特幣溢價指數連 33 日錄得負值，截至台北時間 10 月 26 日最新報 -0.1259%，顯示美國市場買盤偏弱訊號仍未歇。 （前情提要：Coinbase 負溢價 75 天破紀錄！上次翻正後，比特幣漲了兩成） （背景補充：比特幣重挫3.2%至8.15萬、以太坊續走低！全網爆倉「4.7億鎂」恐慌指數回落50） 繼動區先前追蹤美國市場買盤訊號之後，CoinGlass 顯示的 Coinbase 比特幣溢價指數（Coinbase Bitcoin Premium Index）負值連線再度拉長。截至台北時間 10 月 26 日，該指數已連續 33 天落在負值區間，最新報 -0.1259%。 市場解讀上，持續負值多被視為美國市場賣壓較大、買盤偏弱或風險偏好下降的訊號。 連 33 日負溢價，美市買盤偏弱訊號延續 依 CoinGlass 說明，Coinbase 比特幣溢價指數反映 Coinbase（BTC-USD）與 Binance（BTC-USDT）之間的價格差異，用以衡量美國市場相對全球市場的買賣壓力。 指數為正，通常代表 Coinbase 報價較高、美國端出價較積極；為負則代表美國端相對折價，常被讀成買盤偏弱、賣壓較重，或風險偏好降溫。 對照歷史：更長負溢價紀錄與翻正後漲幅 動區先前報導指出，該指數曾自 5 月 19 日起連續 75 天落在負值，當時最新讀數約 -0.0959%，一度刷新有紀錄以來最長連續負溢價。文中並回顧，上一次較長負溢價區間結束後的三個月，比特幣曾出現約兩成漲幅。 另據 ChainCatcher 轉述，8 月 24 日指數曾短暫翻正至約 0.0052%，一度終結自 5 月中旬起算、長達約 97 天的歷史最長負溢價區間。本輪自該次短暫翻正之後，負值又再度連線，至今已超過一個月。 歷史對照能說明負溢價可以拖很久，也能在翻正後伴隨價格修復，但無法保證下一次翻正時間或漲幅重現。 不宜僅憑此斷言「機構資金流出」 多家媒體在引用同一指標時皆加上但書：指數持續為負，可反映美國買盤偏弱或賣壓較大，但不宜僅憑該指標直接認定機構資金正在外流。 原因在於，機構大單與 ETF 相關流動往往走場外（OTC）或 Coinbase Prime 等機構管道，不一定完整反映在公開現貨掛單價差上。負溢價能說的是「公開市場上最積極的出價未必在美國」，不能直接推導成機構正在把幣搬走。 更務實的做法是把溢價指數與 ETF 淨流入／流出、成交量與宏觀風險情緒交叉比對，等待折價收斂、連負天數中斷等可驗證訊號，再評估美市買盤是否真正回溫。 相關報導 Coinbase 負溢價 75 天破紀錄！上次翻正後，比特幣漲了兩成 比特幣重挫3.2%至8.15萬、以太坊續走低！全網爆倉「4.7億鎂」恐慌指數回落50 美股大漲比特幣無感？盤整6.3萬鎂、以太坊回落1851美元，爆倉2.4億鎂恐慌指數回落 比特幣回神站穩6.3萬鎂、以太坊重返1872美元，爆倉1.48億鎂恐慌指數續回升〈Coinbase 比特幣溢價連 33 天負值！美國買盤持續疲軟〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。

articles.title: CoinDCX 認賠 1600 萬鎂！CEO 三天前還說駭案是誤報
articles.excerpt:
印度加密交易所 CoinDCX 承認，因自動掃款服務中斷，約 1599 萬 USDT 滯留舊錢包遭駭客撿走，公 […]

〈 CoinDCX 認賠 1600 萬鎂！CEO 三天前還說駭案是誤報 〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《 動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體 》。

印度加密交易所 CoinDCX 承認，因自動掃款服務中斷，約 1599 萬 USDT 滯留舊錢包遭駭客撿走，公司全額吸收損失。這是在 CEO Sumit Gupta 三天前還在 X 上否認駭案、稱其「只是誤報」之後發生的事。 （前情提要：印度比特幣持有量全球第二：散戶累積100萬枚BTC，政策有望超車美國？） （背景補充：Qubic 鏈重開！1,404 個錢包被盜 140 萬鎂，官方開賠到 2027 年） 印度加密貨幣交易所 CoinDCX 週日早上在官方部落格發布更新，承認公司損失 1599 萬 USDT（約 1600 萬美元）。原因是自動掃款服務在特定時段失效，導致用戶存款累積在已棄用、存在未知漏洞的舊錢包地址上，被駭客一併搬走。CoinDCX 稱這筆損失由公司全額吸收，使用者資金不受影響。 事件的時間線在 X 平台上展開。資產救援服務商 FlashRescue 共同創辦人 Darcy 週三凌晨 1:30（美東時間）率先發帖，指出約 1599 萬 USDT 和 5783.81 枚 TRX 在週二 11:35（美東時間）從 CoinDCX 熱錢包及多個存款地址流出，全部匯入同一個 Tron 地址，最大單筆轉帳為 1581.9 萬 USDT，隨後資金拆分轉往 Binance、OKX、Gate 的存款地址。Darcy 同時點出，這些地址早在 2025 年 7 月 CoinDCX 遭駭時已被入侵。 CEO 否認三天，鏈上證據翻盤 CoinDCX 共同創辦人兼執行長 Sumit Gupta 在三小時內回覆 Darcy，稱「這不正確，CoinDCX 錢包未被入侵」，並說「駭客似乎是在重利用 2025 年 7 月被入侵的舊錢包地址，這聽起來像是一個誤報」。CoinDCX 官方帳號四分鐘後跟進，稱這些說法「具有誤導性」，相關地址自 2025 年 7 月事件後已未被使用。 鏈上分析師 ZachXBT 隨後反駁，指出其中一個存款地址在 2025 年 7 月事件後仍被某流動性供應商使用了 10 個月，且該地址在 2026 年 4 月和 5 月都還將使用者存款掃到 CoinDCX 現行熱錢包。ZachXBT 寫道，這意味著「1580 萬美元的使用者存款未被貴團隊核對」。 Gupta 在凌晨 5:59（美東時間）回覆 ZachXBT，稱團隊正在「進一步調查」，並保證「使用者資金不會損失」。到上午 7:47（美東時間），CoinDCX 官方帳號才正式承認掃款流程「在特定時段」失效，導致「一些營運損失，已由 CoinDCX 吸收」，但當時仍未披露具體金額。ZachXBT 隨後建議使用者「如果你在意你的資產，把 CoinDCX 上的資金全部提領」，並寫道，該交易所共同創辦人「公開和私下都否認資產被竊，這代表他們要麼直白地說謊，要不就是疏忽到不稱職」，同時補充自己仍協助凍結了六位數的被盜加密資產。 2025 年 7 月 4400 萬鎂駭案的回聲 這筆 1600 萬美元損失並非 CoinDCX 第一次資安事故。2025 年 7 月，該交易所曾因一起伺服器入侵事件損失約 4400 萬美元，當時 Gupta 將其歸咎於伺服器洩漏。班加羅爾警方後續調查指出，駭客假扮招聘人員，說服一名 CoinDCX 軟體工程師在公司筆電上安裝惡意軟體，藉此取得交易所內網存取許可權。 CoinDCX 的資安問題並非僅限鏈上攻擊。今年 3 月，印度警方曾以詐欺指控逮捕 Gupta 與共同創辦人 Neeraj Khandelwal，CoinDCX 當時解釋稱這起案件源自仿冒其品牌的假網站。另一方面，Coinbase 在 2025 年 10 月入股 CoinDCX，該筆投資據 Gupta 稱將交易所估值推高至 24.5 億美元，是 Coinbase 深化印度與中東市場布局的一部分。 自動掃款失效的代價：從「誤報」到 1600 萬鎂 CoinDCX 在部落格更新中強調，所有使用者資金仍安全儲存在隔離冷錢包中，受多層保管與離線安全機制保護，交易所的常規交易、存款、提領功能在事件期間照常運作。公司公關代表對 The Block 的追問，僅指向部落格更新，未針對 Gupta 的先前說法或 ZachXBT 的指控作出具體回應。 對市場而言，這起事件的意義不在金額本身，而在於它再次驗證了交易所「自動掃款」機制失效的真實代價。掃款服務本意是將熱錢包與存款地址上的資金定期歸集到冷錢包，一旦中斷，使用者存款就會滯留在可能已被入侵的舊地址上。CoinDCX 在 2025 年 7 月駭案後已停用部分舊錢包，但這些地址顯然未從所有存款流程中完全撤離，流動性供應商仍在使用其中一個地址，導致 1599 萬 USDT 在事件發生時仍暴露在風險中。 對 CoinDCX 使用者來說，公司全額吸收損失的承諾是正面訊號，但 CEO 在事件發生三天內從「誤報」到「調查中」再到「確認損失」的說法轉變，對交易所的資訊透明度是明顯扣分。對更廣泛的加密交易所生態而言，這起事件與近期 Qubic 鏈因弱種子漏洞被竊 140 萬美元、WAX 跨鏈橋遭攻擊等案例一樣，都指向同一個問題：交易所與鏈上基礎設施的資金排程機制，往往在設計上假設「自動化不會失敗」，而一旦失敗，損失就會直接轉嫁到使用者或公司身上。 相關報導 印度比特幣持有量全球第二：散戶累積100萬枚BTC，政策有望超車美國？ Coinbase 印度市場大突破！直接打通盧比銀行管道，支援現貨與合約交易 9 月加密駭案狂飆 7.66 億鎂！Bitget、Liquid Network 雙案佔九成 Qubic 鏈重開！1,404 個錢包被盜 140 萬鎂，官方開賠到 2027 年 印度 USDT 溢價飆破 10%！交易所：不是操控，是供需失衡〈CoinDCX 認賠 1600 萬鎂！CEO 三天前還說駭案是誤報〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。

articles.title: 《影之刃零》評測：招架反擊一氣呵成！攻防流暢、探索豐富的武俠冒險
articles.excerpt:
近期的遊戲市場可謂是大作連發，不僅有《黎明行者之血》、《鬼武者》與《控制：共振》等優秀作品接連登場，在接下來幾天內也有許多備受期待的大作即將上市，其中由中國遊戲團隊靈游坊（S-GAME）開發暨發行、以武俠世界觀為核心的動作遊戲《影之刃零》，即將在 10 月 29 日正式上市，更是許多玩家期待的作品。

近期的遊戲市場可謂是大作連發，不僅有《黎明行者之血》、《鬼武者》與《控制：共振》等優秀作品接連登場，在接下來幾天內也有許多備受期待的大作即將上市，其中由中國遊戲團隊靈游坊（S-GAME）開發暨發行、以武俠世界觀為核心的動作遊戲《影之刃零》，即將在 10 月 29 日正式上市，更是許多玩家期待的作品。

 

本次筆者搶先體驗《影之刃零》PC 版，並已通關遊戲主線，將針對世界探索、戰鬥系統以及角色成長等面向分享實際遊玩心得。本文全程無雷，僅梳理入坑前必知的背景設定，請安心享用。

 

冒險開端

玩家扮演的角色「魂」曾是神祕機構「組織」的利刃，然而遭到昔日的同伴背叛，並且被誣陷成殺害組織首領的兇手。在與摯友「左殤」的對決中深受重傷，命懸一線之時被神秘醫者「鬼手」施以秘術所救，雖然勉強保住性命，但也付出很大的代價，魂只剩下 66 天的壽命。

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

為了探明真相、洗清冤屈，魂在這神秘的武林世界中踏上了絕境旅程。在探尋答案的過程中，玩家將邂逅形形色色的人物與故事。

 

而身處亂世重壓之下，你在關鍵時刻所做出的每一個抉擇，都將深刻影響眾人的命運，並最終指引主角魂走向截然不同的故事結局。

 

本作的難度從簡單到困難依序分為入陣者、破局者與逆天者，其中逆天者的敵人還會有新的招式。

 

而當玩家通關過任一難度之後，將能解鎖新的難度「六十六天」，難度與逆天者相同不過有死亡次數的限制，好消息是遊戲中隨時可以根據自身的需求調整難度，且不會影響成就獲取。

 

 

 

地圖與探索：極為豐富的隱藏要素

本作的地圖設計並非廣袤的開放世界，也不是單調的純線性冒險，而是由多個大型箱庭式關卡所組成的「區域化開放探索」。隨著劇情推進與主角「影之武裝」的解鎖，玩家將能陸續深入更多未知的區域。

 

 

 

遊戲中設有不少暫時封閉的區域，大多需要特定的「影之武裝」來排除障礙才能通行。例如前期就能取得的「巨兇斧」，就能砍破擋路的樹木以開闢新路。

 

此外，影之武裝的種類相當豐富，不僅能大幅輔助地圖探索，在戰鬥中也各具不同的獨特效果。

 

 

 

值得一提的是，本作含有大量的支線任務，且許多都與主線劇情高度相關，甚至會直接影響最終的結局走向。

 

因此強烈建議大家多花時間挑戰支線，除了能解開更多劇情脈絡與影響結局外，完成支線也能獲得相當豐厚的報酬，包含強力武器、飾品以及各類關鍵的強化素材。

 

而且本作的支線任務非常有誠意，絕非單純的跑腿或高重複性作業，每個任務都有獨特的劇情與特色。甚至不少任務在接取的當下無法立刻完成，需要隨著進度推展到後續地圖，才能找到進一步的線索與解答。

 

 

 

遊戲初始時，地圖全貌皆會覆蓋在迷霧之中，直到玩家探索並啟動該區域的「鈴鐺」，才能揭開地圖的迷霧。鈴鐺的功能相當豐富，性質類似於類魂遊戲中的「篝火」不僅能讓主角恢復滿狀態，還具備區域間的快速傳送功能，甚至能直接在此進行武器、飾品與藥品的強化升級。

 

 

 

不過本作本質上並非傳統的類魂遊戲。其中最顯著的差異，就是本作的死亡並沒有懲罰機制，其次是本作在與鈴鐺互動之後，遊戲中的敵人是不會重生的。

 

除了平時能在各個鈴鐺之間自由傳送外，面對某些地形較為複雜或路程較遠的區域，玩家也可以選擇消耗「穿行符」，隨時在野外直接快速傳送至指定的鈴鐺，省去不少來回奔波的時間。

 

 

 

地圖與探索方面，《影之刃零》有著相當豐富的設計。看似錯綜複雜的路線，卻時常會繞回原本的區域，並在過程中開啟新的捷徑；仔細探索也能發現許多開發團隊安排的小巧思，或是在意想不到的角落找到隱藏獎勵，讓探索過程充滿驚喜。

 

除了地圖本身的設計，遊戲也準備了相當豐富的收集品，包括能補充故事劇情與世界觀的文本讀物，以及散落在地圖各處、附帶語音對話的「記憶之花」。後者還能永久提升角色的血量上限，讓探索不只是滿足好奇心，也能實際強化角色能力。

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

戰鬥系統：以「殺氣」為核心的流暢戰鬥

《影之刃零》的戰鬥系統相當豐富，動作的流暢度與打擊感都有著極高水準。加上親民的精準格檔判定與攻防無縫切換的設計，讓整體的對決過程兼具挑戰性與極致流暢的爽快感。

 

本作的戰鬥系統以「殺氣」為核心。攻擊方式分為不消耗資源的基礎攻擊，以及需消耗殺氣值、但傷害與破防效果皆更為強大的「殺氣攻擊」。

 

 

 

有趣的是，遊戲採用了雙武器系統，玩家能在戰鬥中隨時切換武器；切換瞬間不僅能立刻派生銜接招式，還能直接將殺氣值補滿，實用性極高！不過需要注意，武器切換設有些許冷卻時間。

 

此外戰鬥還有一個需要注意的細節，敵人身上皆設有一條「破防值」（護甲/架勢值），只有將其打至見底破防後，後續的攻擊才能造成全額的實質傷害。

 

 

 

由於每款武器的破防能力各有不同，因此在面對持盾或破防值極高的強敵時，便能展現雙武器切換的戰術價值。

 

例如選擇破防能力極強的雙手武器，如前期即可取得的「紅妝鬼斬」來快速削弱敵方架勢；一旦成功打破敵人的防禦，再立刻切回高頻率輸出的主武器進行全力猛攻，這會是不錯的戰鬥策略。

 

 

 

而面對敵人的攻勢，玩家也有相當多元的應對方式。可以選擇長按格檔抵銷傷害，但會持續消耗殺氣；也可以在敵人攻擊命中的瞬間按下格檔使出「精準格檔」，不僅不消耗殺氣，還能連動角色能力暫時提升輸出。

 

若精準格檔敵人的「藍光攻擊」，帶來的回饋會更高，通常能直接造成敵人大幅度的硬直狀態。另外，當敵人使出無法格檔的「紅光攻擊」時，就必須依靠閃避來化解危機。

 

 

 

值得一提的是，本作短按一下的「精準格檔」是不會中斷當前動作的。

 

這意味著玩家可以在持續攻擊敵人的過程中，隨時根據敵人的招式直接按下精準格檔，完全不需要特地收招停手，且判定的寬鬆程度相當親民，極大地提升了戰鬥的流暢度與節奏感。

 

此外，玩家還能施展武器的「絕招」。每種武器都擁有獨特的絕招技能，需消耗不同於一般殺氣的特殊資源「精純殺氣」。

 

絕招除了能造成極高傷害之外，更重要的是具備極強的破防能力，通常還能直接打出大硬直打斷敵人攻勢，因此如何在關鍵時刻精準釋放絕招，將是扭轉戰局的重要課題。

 

 

 

此外，玩家最多能同時裝備兩款「影之武裝」投入戰鬥。雖然影之武裝所需的資源「暗源」補充相對困難，通常需要回到鈴鐺處才能補滿，但中後期的影之武裝在戰局中擁有極強的影響力。

 

例如能強行破防的純暴力型「巨兇斧」、適合遠距離輸出與牽制敵人的「羽弓」，甚至還有能召喚助手協助戰鬥、吸引敵方仇恨的「佛珠」，大幅豐富了戰鬥的戰術選擇。

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

角色成長：鼓勵玩家探索的成長機制

本作並沒有傳統的「角色等級」機制，取而代之的是類似技能樹的「能力修行」，以及透過探索收集品所帶來的成長。玩家能消耗素材與金錢，在能力修行中解鎖各種被動效果。不過這些被動能力大多屬於通用的基礎性能提升。

 

例如前面提到的攻防一體核心「行雲流水」（使閃避與格檔不中斷當前連招）、增加飾品的裝備欄位，或是縮短雙武器切換的冷卻時間等。這些主要是用來優化操作體感，與最終流派（Build）的建構關聯相對較小。

 

 

 

真正的流派建構，主要還是取決於「武器、飾品與影之武裝」三者之間的組合與搭配。

 

以武器「青銅劍」為例，它的特色雖然是無法發動精準格檔，但優勢在於一般格檔所消耗的殺氣值極低；若再進一步搭配能降低格檔殺氣消耗的飾品「神機指環」，就能將這項特長發揮到極致，極大地提升玩家在正面攻防中的續戰力。

 

 

 

 

 

 

飾品分為攻擊、生存與輔助三大類別。玩家的飾品欄位最多可擴充至 6 個，但同類別的飾品上限只能裝備 3 個，因此即便是最熱門的攻擊類飾品，也必須有所取捨、精選其中三種使用。

 

而當遊戲推進至第三章地圖時，還能開啟飾品強化系統，讓飾品的附加效果獲得進一步的提升。

 

 

 

除了裝備與飾品外，探索地圖所獲得的收集品也是能力成長的關鍵：

 

黑石：集齊 4 個黑石碎片可合成一塊完整黑石，能提升 10% 攻擊力與破防能力。

 
殺氣琥珀：集齊 4 個殺氣琥珀碎片可合成一塊殺氣琥珀，能提升 10% 殺氣上限。

 
記憶之花：集滿記憶之花可永久提升角色的血量上限。

 

 

最後在恢復與生存方面，遊戲提供了種類相當豐富的補藥，玩家最多可同時選用兩種攜帶。每種補藥的效果皆有不同。

 

例如初始的「藥葫蘆」屬於最通用的瞬間補血；而後續取得的「歸神湯」則兼具恢復與提升防禦力的效果，能大幅增強生存能力。

 

值得一提的是，這些補藥在戰鬥中皆可放心地彈性使用，因為只要與「鈴鐺」互動便會自動補滿，並不是需要花錢購買的消耗品。

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

角色成長方面的設計，很明顯是鼓勵玩家多探索，也相當鼓勵玩家多做支線任務。透過將獎勵回饋直接與探索、支線深度綁定，讓玩家也有足夠的動機去探索世界。

 

結語

整體來看，筆者認為《影之刃零》憑藉流暢攻防的戰鬥體驗、充滿驚喜的箱庭探索，以及與探索深度綁定的角色養成，提供了相當優秀的遊戲體驗。

 

遊戲在保有動作遊戲深度與挑戰性的同時，也透過親民的招架判定與友善的死亡機制，大幅降低玩家的挫折感也提升遊戲的體驗。

 

如果你喜歡爽快俐落的招架反擊、沉浸感十足的戰鬥體驗，同時也熱愛在武俠世界中自由探索，那麼本作絕對是值得推薦的作品！

 

 

 

《影之刃 零》將於 2026 年 10 月 29 日於 PS5、Steam 上推出。

articles.title: IT早报 1026：苹果 iPhone Duo 热门游戏内屏黑边引吐槽；星闪 3.0 成果发布；张雪成功挑战摩托水上漂吉尼斯世界纪录；小米武汉员工住宅光谷梦享家开盘...
articles.excerpt:
“IT早报”时间，大家好，现在是 2026 年 10 月 26 日星期一，今天的重要科技资讯有：

1. 苹果 iPhone Duo 内屏玩《王者荣耀》《原神》暂不支持全屏显示，大黑边被网友吐槽“公摊广告位”

据多位博主、网友分享，腾讯《王者荣耀》和米哈游的《原神》这两款热门游戏暂未适配苹果最新折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo。玩家使用该机内屏游玩上述两款游戏时，会出现无法全屏显示的问题。该情况也迅速引发网友吐槽，称内屏的黑边是“公摊广告位”、“公摊面积”。>> 查看详情 

 

2. 星闪 3.0 标准成果发布：华为、中国移动、联想等共建，面向全场景智能物联，瞄准 AI、无源、毫米波等方向

在以“星闪 AI · 智合万物”为主题的 CEIC2026 暨国际星闪联盟产业峰会，星闪 3.0 标准成果正式发布。据介绍，3.0 将面向全场景智能物联，瞄准 AI、无源、毫米波等方向进行创新，已正式发布无损音频等三项标准，另外还有大量标准正在制定中，目前已经取得了阶段性成果。>> 查看详情 

 

3. 40.74 公里！张雪时隔 17 年圆梦“水上漂”，刷新改装摩托车在开阔水域行驶最远距离吉尼斯世界纪录

“张雪机车”创始人张雪 10 月 25 日驾驶改装摩托车 MX450，在湖南省怀化市麻阳苗族自治县郭公坪镇小坡村，成功挑战“改装摩托车在开阔水域行驶最远距离”吉尼斯世界纪录。>> 查看详情 

 

4. 小米第一代员工住宅项目「光谷梦享家」10 月 25 日开盘：共建 4 栋楼，三种户型全覆盖 297 户

小米生态链总经理陈波 10 月 24 日发布视频，宣布小米员工住宅项目 ——「光谷梦享家」10 月 25 日正式开盘。公开信息显示，小米「光谷梦享家」项目距小米武汉科技园约 700 米，是武汉首个小米同学定制化住宅，面向小米集团正式员工销售。目前，项目营销中心、样板间、休闲会所实景开放。>> 查看详情 

 

5. 苹果 iPhone Duo 在部分区域破发：已加入电商平台“百亿补贴”，相对上市价便宜约 200-300 元

虽然首发日一度被加价 1500-2000 元，但开售仅两天后 iPhone Duo 就在部分区域出现破发，拼多多百亿补贴频道售价较上市价便宜约 200-300 元。不过 Apple Store 门店仍无现货，官网送货要等到明年 1 月。>> 查看详情 

 

6. 古尔曼：苹果首款触屏 MacBook Pro 北京时间 10 月 29 日发布，标志公司产品策略迎来重大转变

这款产品将提供 14 和 16 英寸两种尺寸，首次引入 OLED 屏幕和灵动岛设计，并搭载专为触控交互设计的 macOS 27 Golden Gate。这意味着苹果彻底扭转了乔布斯时代对触屏笔记本的否定态度。>> 查看详情 

7. 2027 羊年央视春晚总导演公布，于蕾连续五年扛起重任

总台 10 月 25 日官宣，于蕾出任 2027 丁未羊年央视春晚总导演，这是她自 2023 兔年起连续第五年执掌春晚。2027 年春节为 2 月 6 日，除夕为 2 月 5 日，当晚将举行羊年春晚。>> 查看详情 

8. 《流浪地球 3（上）》电影全新物料即将发布，2027 年春节档上映

在第三十届全国影片推介会上，影片正式亮相并宣布全新物料即将发布。郭帆执导，吴京、刘德华等原班人马回归，沈腾、杨紫琼、克里斯托弗 · 瓦尔兹全新加盟，系列将分为上下两部。>> 查看详情 

9. 铺路铺到苹果家：开发者成功令微软 Surface Duo 2 运行 iOS / iPadOS 26 系统

开发者 @none25smu 展示了跨平台移植新成果，让微软 Surface Duo 2 成功运行 iPadOS 26。项目仍处早期阶段，但已实现双屏运行与硬件加速，帧率从 3-10 FPS 提升至 37 FPS。开发者还计划将 iOS 移植到初代 Surface Duo。>> 查看详情 

10. 比亚迪腾势 Z9GT 在香港上市，99.8 万港元

新车是香港市场首款搭载极速闪充与第二代刀片电池的豪华车型，采用经典 GT 车身设计。动力上拥有 850kW 峰值功率，零百加速仅 2.7 秒，配备 1000V 高压平台和易三方智能控制系统。>> 查看详情 

11. 古尔曼：苹果正为 iPhone Duo 开发全新“便捷访问”模式，方便左撇子用户根据持机习惯调整界面

据彭博社记者马克・古尔曼透露，苹果正为 iPhone Duo 开发新便捷访问模式，可将外屏内容移至左侧或右侧。同时，IDC 预计其首年出货量超 1000 万部，高盛更是预测 2027 年出货量达 3300 万部。>> 查看详情 

12. 国内首部 AI 院线长片《三星堆：未来往事》，票房过百万

《三星堆：未来往事》国内首部获国家电影局公映许可证的 AI 全流程院线长片，上映两天票房达 116.2 万。影片片长 100 分钟，依托博纳自研“博卡电影云片场”完成，团队历时两年产出 120 余万张底图。>> 查看详情 

13. 比亚迪在韩销量激增，现代起亚本土市场承压

比亚迪低价车型在韩销量飙升，今年前 8 月增长至原先九倍，9 月新车登记量达 2 万台。现代起亚在价格竞争中承压，分析师警告服务网络与维修成本或是中国品牌长期障碍。>> 查看详情 

14. 美运营商 Verizon 为苹果 iPhone Duo 预购延迟发货致歉，向受影响顾客赠送 100 美元礼品卡

有用户原本预计 10 月 23 日发售当日送达，但送达日期被推迟至 11 月 7 日甚至更晚。Verizon 表示正加快处理订单，下周将通过电子邮件发送礼品卡，可在线上或线下门店使用。>> 查看详情 

15. 吉利全新帝豪向上系列车型上市：FlymeAuto2，限时感恩价 5.99 万元起

新车共推出 3 款车型，外观延续家族设计但细节调整，提供阿尔卑斯金等配色。内饰升级 12.8 英寸悬浮中控屏，搭载 FlymeAuto2 智能座舱，动力搭载 1.5L 四缸发动机。>> 查看详情 

 

16. 腾讯《王者荣耀》暂未开放 iPhone Duo 机型 120 帧模式，Air 用户苦等一年也仍未解锁

据玩家反馈，腾讯《王者荣耀》除了暂未适配 iPhone Duo 的内屏显示外，还没有开放该机型的 120 帧模式。作为参考，iPhone Air 也未解锁《王者荣耀》的 120 帧模式。>> 查看详情 

17. 卢伟冰再谈小米 18 Fold 手机折痕：采用新一代折叠架构，平均深度 ≤30μm

小米集团合伙人 / 总裁、手机部总裁、小米品牌总经理卢伟冰 10 月 25 日发文，再度谈及了小米 18 Fold 中折叠手机的折痕情况：采用新一代折叠架构，强度更高，更抗冲击，同时带来超强折痕控制，平均折痕深度 ≤30μm。>> 查看详情 

18. 张雪谈成功挑战“水上漂”吉尼斯世界纪录自己表现：打 99 分，留 1 分不要太骄傲

“张雪机车”创始人张雪 10 月 25 日驾驶改装摩托车 MX450，在湖南省怀化市麻阳苗族自治县郭公坪镇小坡村，成功挑战“改装摩托车在开阔水域行驶最远距离”吉尼斯世界纪录。赛后，张雪在接受采访时表示，挑战过程中发挥还是很稳定的，出去之后没有刻意拉高车速。如果没有挑战成功，还是很丢脸的，所以很谨慎。张雪还给自己的表现打了 99 分，称留 1 分不要太骄傲。>> 查看详情 

19. 小米 18 Fold 中折叠手机官宣适配娱乐工作各类应用，网友热评“终于迎来最佳宣发期”

小米手机官方 10 月 24 日发文，介绍 18 Fold 中折叠手机的应用适配情况：适配爱奇艺、网易云音乐、高德、WPS 等各类应用，从休闲娱乐到日常工作，全面覆盖。有网友评论称：“终于迎来了最佳宣发期。”>> 查看详情 

 

20. 苹果 iPhone Duo 部分区域破发，王腾称相比小米、华为阔折叠手机没有特别领先的地方

今日宜休科技公司创始人王腾 10 月 25 日发文，谈及了 iPhone Duo 破发这一话题。他表示：上手体验了下 iPhone Duo，整体还是挺精致的，但相比小米、华为的阔折叠并没有什么特别领先的地方。今天依托优秀的工程师团队和强大的产业链资源，中国的科技团队，在大多数领域都能做出不逊于海外友商，甚至是更好的产品。>> 查看详情 

21. 华为 Mate 90 RS / Pro Max 典藏版推 HarmonyOS 7.0.0.111SP13 升级，优化与睿影 Z10 模块相机连接

华为 Mate 90 RS 非凡大师和 Mate 90 Pro Max 典藏版推送了鸿蒙 HarmonyOS 7.0.0.111SP13 版本升级。据用户反馈，该版本优化了与华为睿影 Z10 模块相机的连接体验，此前有消息称在更新 111 SP12 版本后无法连接睿影 Z10（概率性复现）。>> 查看详情 

22. 苹果 iPhone Duo 耐用性测试：反向弯折内屏开裂

博主 JerryRigEverything 对 iPhone Duo 进行暴力测试，外屏超瓷晶面板表现强悍，但内屏抗刮一般，且在展开状态下遭反向弯折后玻璃迅速开裂。测试还模拟了日常沙尘与锁子甲摩擦场景，结果出人意料。>> 查看详情 

 

今天就先聊到这里，IT早报，咱们明天见。

The post A total of $541m was raised this week across 16 FinTech deals appeared first on FinTech Global .

It was a modest week for FinTech deals this week, with a total of $541m raised across 16 deals.  

This represented a significant drop from the previous week , which saw $2.8bn raised across 17 deals. However, the lion share of the funding from that week came from the colossal $1.85bn investment secured by Ramp.

Despite the small total funding for the week, more than half was accounted for by just two deals.

The biggest deal of this week was secured by California-based infrastructure and enterprise software company Whop. It closed its Series D round at a $5.1bn valuation, coming just months after a $200m strategic investment from Tether had valued the business at $1.6bn.

Salmon, a philippine banking and lending platform, was the only other FinTech to break the $100m mark this week. The software developer netted $140m as it looks to expand its product line across the country.

The infrastructure and enterprise software was the strongest subsector of the week accounting for six of the 17 deals. These were Whop, Salmon, CapitalOS, Prism Data, ScribeUp and Vrtx.

Following behind were the RegTech and CyberTech sectors, which recorded three deals apiece. The RegTechs were Mural, Pennant and CoComply, while the CyberTechs were Opsin, Ultra Security and Asymptote Labs.

Rounding of the deals were marketplace lending and InsurTech with two deals each. The lending FinTechs were Cognitive Credit and Plinto, and the InsurTechs were Slingshot Insurance and Cachet.

The WealthTech subsector did not secure any deals this week, despite it having a very strong Q3. Research from FinTech Global recently noted that global WealthTech funding surged three-times QoQ in Q3. A total of $2.8bn was raised across 124 deals, compared to $932.2m across 151 deals in Q2 2026.

On the topic of WealthTech, FinTech Global recently spoke to several leaders in the space to get their thoughts on how the space will evolve in the coming years. As we edge closer to 2030, they were asked what the big shifts will be over the coming years, the biggest internal changes and what trends firms are currently underestimating. The full feature can be read here. 

In terms of location the US continued to hold its crown as the biggest hub for FinTech. It was home to 10 of the 16 deals, including seven of the 10 biggest deals. The US-based FinTechs in this week’s roundup are Whop, Mural, Slingshot Insurance, CapitalOS, Ospin, Prism Data, ScribeUp, Ultra Security, Asymptote Labs and Pennant.

The UK was the only other country to record multiple FinTech deals this week. These were the funding rounds for Cognitive Credit and CoComply.

As for the remaining deals, the other countries represented this week were the Philippines (Salmon), Estonia (Cachet), Saudi Arabia (Vrtx) and Denmark (Plinto).

Despite the US maintaining its dominance in the number of deals, the sizable funding round secured by the Philippines-based Salmon show countries across the world are still building major FinTech players.

 Recent research from FinTech Global highlighted this. In Q3 2026, the ten biggest deals of the quarter ranged across seven countries. While the US was the only one with multiple deals in the chart, including the biggest deal of the three months, the rest of the list was fairly diverse. The UK, Singapore, Saudi Arabia, Hong Kong, Indonesia and Italy were the other countries to feature in the top 10.

 

While on the topic of global FinTech funding during Q3, a total of $27.5bn was raised across 897 deals, representing a 35% increase in funding when compared to Q3 2025. The average deal size during the period was $30.6m, up from $21.2m in Q3 2025.

Here are the 16 FinTech funding rounds covered on FinTech Global this week

Whop raises $200m Series D at $5.1bn valuation

 Whop , a California-based technology firm aiming to give everyone access to a sustainable income, has closed a $200m Series D funding round that values the business at $5.1bn. 

Sequoia and Shopify Ventures co-led the investment. Whop plans to use the fresh capital to scale its international presence and step up research and development, with a focus on making payments and advertising markets work far more efficiently. This is the second time Whop has raised money in 2026.

In February, Tether made a $200m strategic investment in the company at a $1.6bn valuation.

Around 25,000 business operators currently use Whop, collectively generating $550m every month. A further 50,000-plus people earn money each month by supplying services to those businesses.

Over the last three months, Whop has rolled out several new products. Business Blueprints allows newcomers to set up a business that is ready to start selling within a few clicks, and more than 21,000 businesses have been launched through it in the six weeks since its debut.

Whop serves business operators ranging from product leads at fast-growing startups to teenage first-time founders, offering them a gamified interface and a broad API that support distribution, company creation and payments. Most firms on the platform target narrow, specialised customer needs rather than mass-market audiences, taking advantage of the internet’s ability to reach niches once considered too small to sustain a business.

Salmon raises $140m to deepen Philippine lending push

 Salmon Group , a Philippine banking and lending platform built on technology, has raised a further $140m (PHP 8.8bn) as it concentrates its ambitions entirely on the Philippine market and prepares to take new credit products nationwide. 

The new capital is earmarked for two priorities. First, Salmon plans to expand its existing profitable lending lines, namely the Salmon Credit Line and its in-store lending offer. Second, it will finance a national launch of fresh products, with motorcycle loans and lending to micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) leading the pipeline.

The raise follows a period of rapid expansion. Salmon has been operating for under four years and in that time has positioned itself among the quickest-growing technology firms in the country. Its structure combines two regulated entities: Salmon Bank (Rural Bank), which holds a licence from the BSP, and Salmon Finance, a financing company licensed by the SEC.

Customer reach is delivered through the Salmon app, which serves millions of Filipinos. The app has recorded 9 million downloads and carries a 4.8 rating across both the App Store and Google Play. Salmon also reports 99.9% uptime and round-the-clock customer support.

Salmon Finance, which acts as the group’s financing arm, uses an AI-driven credit engine to assess applicants. This allows the company to lend to people with thin credit files and return decisions in a matter of minutes, a capability central to its strategy of widening access to credit.

Cognitive Credit lands $40m as AI reshapes credit research

 Cognitive Credit , a provider of corporate credit data, analytics and AI tools, has closed a $40m strategic growth investment as institutional investors push for verifiable data to underpin AI-driven credit analysis. 

Summit Partners led the round, and existing backer ETFS Capital also took part. Chris Bon, a partner at Summit Partners, has taken a seat on the Cognitive Credit board of directors. The capital will fund the company’s commercial push in the US and the development of its next product generation.

Two launches sit at the centre of that roadmap. DealConnect, due imminently, will let users pull detailed credit models on demand for private issuers whose reporting is shared through secure data rooms.

The company is also preparing to deploy agentic credit analysis, which layers advanced AI over its verified data to automate in-depth fundamental research. Cognitive Credit plans to keep extending its issuer coverage into additional credit markets.

The firm operates a web application that supports analysts at each stage of credit research, pairing verified data with analytics and generative AI built for the credit domain. Its proprietary dataset, derived from the analysis of hundreds of thousands of financial reports, gives users audit-grade credit models and primary reporting libraries for more than 3,500 corporate bond and loan issuers across the US, Europe and emerging markets.

Mural raises $28m to power FinTechs and agentic finance

 Mural , a compliant system of record that FinTechs and platforms use to move, store and grow customer money, has brought its total funding to $28m after closing a fresh Series A round. 

The $15m Series A was led by Tether, with North Island Ventures and the firm’s existing backers also taking part.

The company plans to put the capital towards strengthening its infrastructure for moving, holding and growing money, growing its team, widening its licensing and compliance coverage, and bringing additional markets onto what it describes as the Global Financial Internet.

The business was born out of a challenge its founders, Sinclair Toffa and Chris Fernandes, encountered while working as engineers at Palantir, where they connected fragmented systems for Fortune 100 firms. Mural says many global companies rely on a patchwork of financial tools, banking partners and compliance providers to deliver financial products, with no single layer tying them together. The company presents itself as a reimagining of that integration work, built specifically for the financial sector.

Mural offers a single platform covering the accounts, payments, identity and compliance functions that sit behind its customers’ financial products. It takes responsibility for the licences, banking relationships, and both local and blockchain payment rails needed to operate in multiple markets. Its forward deployed engineers work directly with clients in each market and support them through launch.

Slingshot Insurance raises $27m for embedded InsurTech

 Slingshot Insurance , an AI-native insurer focused on the embedded economy, has launched publicly after operating in stealth, revealing that it has secured $27m in seed capital. 

Rally Ventures and Skyward Group jointly led the oversubscribed round. A number of property and casualty (P&C) insurance veterans also invested, among them Jim Hays, who is set to take a seat on the company’s board of directors.

The raise comes as embedded insurance gains momentum within the wider P&C landscape. According to industry projections cited by the company, embedded policies currently make up around 3% of worldwide P&C premiums, a share that could climb to close to 20% within ten years, growing considerably faster than the overall market.

Slingshot was co-founded by Rally Ventures and Ethan Genteman, who previously served as chief actuarial officer at Palomar Holdings. The business aims to support those operating in the embedded space, such as vertical software platforms, managing general agents (MGAs) and insurance distributors, by giving them the technology, capacity and pace needed to bring new products to market and grow them. Target areas include fast-moving niches like amateur sports, travel and the gig and independent-work economy.

The company’s platform is built specifically for the demands of embedded insurance, where large volumes of products generate significant transactional and data complexity. Rather than relying on spreadsheets, email chains and disjointed legacy systems, Slingshot offers one unified system that applies AI to automate intricate workflows, while APIs link it directly to MGAs, distribution partners and capital providers. Each decision made on the platform can be audited, reconciled and explained, offering greater visibility, speed and insight to MGAs and those supplying capital.

CapitalOS bags $21.9m to turn software into finance teams

 CapitalOS has secured $21.9m in Series A funding, a move that could reshape how B2B platforms compete for the businesses that rely on them. 

LGVP led the round, with new backing from WEX Venture Capital, Group11, Great North Ventures and Night Capital. Existing investors also took part. CapitalOS plans to use the capital to substantially expand the infrastructure it has built. The raise follows an 18-month period in which volume processed through the platform rose more than twentyfold.

CapitalOS gives software companies the tools to roll out financial products within weeks or even days. It absorbs the work of compliance, risk management and underwriting, sparing platforms from recruiting specialists, building dedicated engineering teams or maintaining infrastructure for years. Its offering rests on four components. Bills handles supplier payments by assessing terms, payment options and timing.

Cards provides issuing with built-in spending limits and captures context at the point of purchase. Wallets holds business cash, moving idle funds into treasury for yield and ring-fencing reserves for payroll, tax and growth. Receivables manages invoicing, chases late payments and reconciles settled amounts.

Looking forward, the company expects platforms to differentiate by offering financial operations built around the industries they serve, giving smaller firms access to capabilities once limited to large enterprises.

Opsin raises $21m as AI agents outpace legacy security

 Opsin , a security company focused on governing enterprise AI agents, has secured $21m in a funding round co-led by SYN Ventures and Race Capital. 

The company will put the capital towards accelerating product development, extending its reach among enterprises in regulated sectors, broadening its risk protection layer as agents gain more autonomy, and recruiting additional staff. Opsin views the investment as evidence that the market is moving towards a new security model designed specifically for agents.

According to Opsin, traditional enterprise defences were designed to watch endpoints, networks and the exchange of prompts and responses. Agents, by contrast, operate server-side, plug straight into corporate data and can take action on their own. Existing tools cannot assess whether an agent’s conduct remains consistent with the job it was built to do.

To address this, Opsin created a standardised agent model that brings consistency to how agents are classified across Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Claude Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise and Gemini.

After identifying thousands of projects and recurring patterns of data oversharing, the firm made agent posture, covering connectors, tool calls and sharing scope, alongside runtime behaviour, the core inputs for understanding each agent. Runtime signals include an agent reaching beyond its role or passing sensitive data to users whose roles do not match.

This information feeds the Opsin Risk Graph, which learns continuously from agent activity to spot new threats. If an agent breaches policy, the platform can quarantine it, block the action or alert its owner with remediation guidance.

Opsin originally launched to help enterprises curb data oversharing as AI adoption grew. It has since widened its scope from securing data in motion to overseeing the identities, intents, connectors, tool calls and permissions of agents.

The platform connects through an API, requires no specialist training and produces an initial risk assessment of agents across approved AI platforms within 24 hours. Its customers range from mid-sized firms to Fortune 500 companies in healthcare, financial services, manufacturing and other regulated industries.

Looking three years ahead, Opsin expects agents to interact with one another far more than with people, with much of that exchange never seen by a human as it happens. The company argues this calls for governing agents as organisations govern employees: judging them on their actions and the requirements of their role, rather than restricting their speed.

 

 

Prism Data raises $20m to scale cash flow underwriting

 Prism Data , a US-based provider of cash flow underwriting and credit analytics technology, has secured $20m in Series A funding as banks and lenders turn to real-time banking data to judge creditworthiness. 

Story Ventures led the round, which also drew backing from FINTOP, Core VC, Obvious Ventures, 1st & Main Growth Partners and Mana Ventures.

With the $5m seed round it disclosed in 2023, the business has now raised more than $25m in total.

Prism plans to use the money to keep investing in its technology, proprietary AI infrastructure and data science teams. That work includes building a new generation of its CashScore models. The company also intends to grow in consumer and small business lending, strengthen its position in the US and Canada, and eventually take its products to international markets.

Alongside the raise, Prism has launched REFRACT, an AI-driven engine for categorising transactions. It was trained on the company’s own dataset of more than 30 billion bank transactions.

Conventional tools label transactions using merchant names or keywords. REFRACT instead uses separate consumer and commercial models to work out what each payment is actually for. Drawing on contextual signals, it can tell apart activity that looks the same on a statement, such as earnings versus borrowed money, refunds versus income, and purchases versus transfers, even when one payment platform is involved in all of them.

According to the firm, benchmark tests show double-digit percentage improvements in accuracy over its earlier models. The engine can process data from any open banking aggregator, from banks’ own deposit accounts, and from PDF statements in the US and Canada. It also monitors for new kinds of transactions and counterparties, including those linked to newer products such as prediction markets.

Prism’s growth has been rapid. Lender requests to its API have risen more than 100-fold over two years, an average compounded increase of more than 20% each month.

ScribeUp raises $13m as banks fight to own the bill layer

 ScribeUp , an AI-driven provider of embedded recurring bill tools for financial institutions, has secured $13m in a Series A round as lenders face mounting pressure to keep control of everyday consumer spending. 

Curql led the round, joined by Mucker Capital and Service Ventures. The financing combines $10m of equity with a $3m venture debt facility.

The platform sits inside a bank’s existing digital channels and pairs data on recurring payments with wider account context, such as balances, cash flow, the timing of payments and the institution’s own product range.

Rather than simply warning customers that a payment is approaching, it lets them act. A user can cancel a subscription they no longer use, switch the card or account linked to a biller, draw on an advance or move an outside loan to a new lender. Its agentic technology allows any supported biller action to be completed on any monitored bill without leaving the banking app.

ScribeUp counts over 60 banks, credit unions, FinTechs and neobanks among its clients and already connects to leading digital banking platforms. Institutions can roll out the service by SDK, iframe or API, which spares them from developing the underlying systems in-house.

The new capital will fund further work on AI-native intelligence and agentic execution, alongside hiring and go-to-market activity.

Ultra Security raises $10m as AI agents outrun defences

 Ultra Security , a developer of security tooling for autonomous AI agents, has emerged from stealth with $10m in seed capital, betting that firms can no longer afford to discover what their agents did only after the damage is done. 

The round drew backing from Ludlow Ventures, Hidden Capital, Entrée Capital, Detroit Venture Partners, firedrop and FDVC. Angel investors drawn from the security and SaaS sectors also took part.

The company positions its platform as a checkpoint between AI agents and the MCP servers and connectors those agents rely on. Each prompt, data retrieval and tool invocation passes through Ultra, giving organisations live oversight and control of agent behaviour rather than a retrospective view.

Ultra argues that the timing is pressing. Agents have evolved from simple chatbots into software with genuine access to corporate systems, including email and code, and MCP is fast becoming the default route through which they reach tools, APIs and sensitive data. According to the firm, adoption is outpacing the monitoring tools designed to keep watch.

The platform combines four capabilities. Its guardrails convert plain-language policies into real-time enforcement, blocking credential access, redacting PII, protecting PHI, limiting abuse and preventing data moving between connectors, with rules applicable to an entire organisation, a team or one device.

Asymptote Labs raises $5.5m to tame unchecked AI agents

 Asymptote Labs , a developer of runtime infrastructure for AI agents, has secured $5.5m in an oversubscribed seed round, betting that companies deploying autonomous agents at scale will soon need a single system of record to monitor and control them. 

Tower Research Ventures, the venture arm of trading firm Tower Research Capital, led the investment. Lytical Ventures, 1984 Ventures and South Park Commons also took part. The startup plans to direct the capital towards engineering, product development, recruitment and its commercial push.

The raise comes as enterprises roll out growing numbers of AI agents across staff workstations, cloud environments and business processes.

These agents can reach sensitive data, alter code and trigger actions within critical systems, yet security and engineering teams often have little insight into how they behave or how to contain the risks they introduce.

Central to the company’s offering is Beacon, an open-source telemetry layer released under the MIT licence. It records agent activity across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and over 20 further agent harnesses, converting that activity into a standard runtime data model built on top of the OpenTelemetry standard.

Organisations gain a consolidated view of every agent while retaining ownership of the underlying data. Developers also benefit, as insights from earlier coding sessions persist instead of being lost when a session closes.

Pennant secures $5m seed to modernise proxy voting with AI

 Pennant , an AI-native platform designed to support corporate governance decisions, has closed a $5m seed round to develop what it describes as a world model for the governance of public companies. 

Urban Innovation Fund led the investment, with Y Combinator also taking part. A number of strategic angel backers joined the round, among them people currently or previously connected with Marvell Technology, Legal & General, OpenAI, Kirkland & Ellis and NVIDIA.

The startup argues that while institutional investors control trillions of dollars of capital in public markets, and companies face mounting demands around governance and shareholder relations, the systems linking these groups have lagged behind. According to Pennant, research, voting and engagement still rely on scattered data, manual processes and a small number of established advisory firms, meaning governance tooling has failed to grow alongside the scale of ownership.

Proxy voting is the first area Pennant is tackling. Its platform brings together an institution’s own research, voting guidelines and historical decisions, allowing investors to apply independent judgement across large volumes of votes. Over time, the system builds up an institutional memory, becoming more effective with each vote cast and each engagement carried out.

The firm already counts US pension funds, institutional asset managers and prominent governance and legal advisers among its customers. Prior to entering Y Combinator, Pennant was chosen for the Palantir Startup Fellowship.

Vrtx bags $3.6m to rebuild Saudi embedded finance rails

 Vrtx , a Saudi-based embedded finance infrastructure provider, has closed a $3.6m pre-seed round as it seeks to remove the heavy build burden facing companies that want to offer financial services in the Kingdom. 

SCV by Standard Chartered led the list of backers, joined by Sadu Capital, BYLD, Suhail Ventures, F6 Ventures, TAZ Investment and Palm Ventures.

The company has also secured In-Principle Approval (IPA) from the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) for an Electronic Money Institution (EMI) licence. This regulatory milestone moves Vrtx closer to delivering its services within Saudi Arabia’s supervisory framework.

Launching products there exposed the founders to a recurring obstacle: even basic financial offerings demand that technology, operations, compliance and security all be developed simultaneously. They set up Vrtx to ease that burden.

The firm combines the infrastructure and operational tooling businesses need to embed financial services, covering wallets, payouts, card issuance, transfers and transaction processing. Rather than forcing firms to construct systems, link up payment flows and run operations independently, Vrtx wants to offer a faster, less complicated route to going live.

Its platform includes a secure sandbox, step-by-step workflows and an operational layer designed to scale. Vrtx hopes this combination will shorten the journey from concept to launch while giving clients tighter oversight of balances, transactions and financial rules, without burdening them with excess technical or operational work.

Plinto secures €2.9m ($3.25m) to drive real-time finance with AI

 Plinto , a FinTech company focused on bringing real-time finance to businesses, has closed a €2.9m pre-seed round backed by People Ventures and Emblem. 

The two investors joined the round on the basis of a shared belief in where financial controlling is heading. Plinto argues that oversight of company finances is moving away from being the responsibility of a single dedicated team and towards a distributed model spanning the whole organisation, with agents coordinating the process.

The new capital will be put towards speeding up product development and entering new markets. Plinto said the investment is intended to help a wider range of companies tap into the potential of AI and transition towards finance that operates in real time.

People Ventures is an operationally focused early-stage fund headquartered in Copenhagen with a Nordic remit. It supports founders hands-on across areas including finance, sales and go-to-market strategy, and counts Pandektes, Hosted.ai and After Technologies among its portfolio companies.

Plinto was founded to address a problem in finance that the company says remained unresolved for decades because the available technology was not up to the task. Its platform now reviews thousands of transactions each day and takes action on them. The firm’s stated ambition is for finance to keep pace with the business itself, operating in real time.

CoComply raises £1.9m ($2.5m) to expose hidden workforce risk

 CoComply , a UK RegTech scale-up focused on external workforce compliance, has secured £1.9m to speed up product development and expand its presence both at home and abroad. 

NPIF – Mercia Equity Finance led the round. The fund is run by Mercia Ventures within the Northern Powerhouse Investment Fund II (NPIF II). UK venture capital firm Haatch, which pairs capital with hands-on support for founders, also took part, alongside management and other investors.

Those backers include Richard Law, the former CEO of GBG and a technology investor with a portfolio that features Vypr, who will take on the role of chair. They also include Seb Timpson, co-founder of With Intelligence, a financial data and intelligence firm that S&P Global bought for $1.8bn in November 2025, and Stephen Cann, CEO of Bollin Group, owner of brands such as Mountain Equipment, Sprayway, Ronhill and Bridgedale.

CoComply serves mid-market and large organisations. Its platform surfaces external workers, including those concealed within supplier contracts, and maps how each person is engaged. It then sets out which compliance checks apply. The AI-native system pairs automation with specialist classification expertise and operates at the moment work first arrives in a business.

From there, it helps teams define the work required, choose a suitable engagement route, classify workers accurately and settle the approvals needed. The emphasis is on prevention. The goal is to catch exposure around worker classification and IR35, Right to Work and modern slavery before it becomes a liability.

The new capital will fund product work and a larger sales, marketing and delivery operation. This supports the company’s long-term aim of categorising and classifying the global workforce so that compliance holds everywhere.

Cachet raises funding to expand adaptive insurance platform

 Cachet , a Tallinn-based InsurTech broker specialising in insurance for Europe’s platform economy, has raised fresh capital led by Nordic investor Spintop Ventures , bringing its total funding to around €11m as it looks to expand its adaptive insurance offering. 

Spintop Ventures led the round, with existing investors Truffle Capital and Icebreaker.vc also participating. Cachet will use the funding to develop its products and expand its sales team, while adapting its offering to new forms of platform-based work, including employer-of-record arrangements. The company is also preparing its platform for the arrival of autonomous vehicles on European roads.

The investment comes as ride-sharing, micromobility and gig economy platforms increasingly require insurance that reflects how their businesses operate. Traditional policies are often priced annually and arranged separately in each country, despite exposure changing with individual journeys and vehicle use.

Cachet provides insurance tailored to how people work and vehicles are used, integrating cover into platform operators’ systems and managing policy administration and claims. Established insurers continue to underwrite the risks.

The company has more than doubled in size year on year and recorded its first full year of positive EBITDA in 2025. It operates across multiple segments in the 16 European countries where it is licensed, with partners including Bolt, Voi, Ryde and Turo. Since launching, Cachet has covered close to 2bn minutes of mobility, with more than 310,000 assets on its platform.

articles.title: CoinDCX Admits $16M Loss Just Days After CEO Denied Fresh Wallet Breach
articles.excerpt:
The exchange said the loss was absorbed by the company and customer funds remained unaffected.

One of India’s leading crypto trading platforms, CoinDCX, confirmed that suspicious activity detected earlier this week ultimately led to a 15.99 million USDT loss tied to wallet infrastructure compromised during a previous security incident.

The admission comes only days after CEO Sumit Gupta publicly said the exchange’s wallets had not been breached and suggested the alarm could be linked to attackers reusing old addresses.

The company’s official October 25 update says the team noticed unusual activity on October 21 and initially prevented any impact to its active wallet and trading infrastructure.

However, they detected irregular blockchain movements shortly after and launched a deeper investigation, which determined that the activity had affected an old, deprecated operational wallet infrastructure containing previously unknown vulnerabilities.

CoinDCX also discovered that an automated sweeping service had failed for some time, and deposits sent by users to one of the deprecated addresses accumulated there instead of being transferred into the exchange’s current secure wallet infrastructure.

 
“This led to a loss of 15.99 million USDT, which was absorbed by the company,” adds the statement.

The exchange stressed that its active wallets, trading systems, deposits, and withdrawals continued operating normally and that customer balances were fully accounted for. Users who mistakenly deposited to deprecated addresses were still immediately credited, while a separate process was supposed to sweep those funds elsewhere.

Interestingly, this acknowledgment is particularly noteworthy given Gupta’s initial response just three days earlier. After blockchain researchers flagged roughly $16 million in suspicious transfers, the exec stated that “CoinDCX wallets are not breached” and warned against spreading false rumors.

He said at the time that the addresses involved had belonged to the exchange before its July 2025 hack and had been compromised during the incident.

 

Thanks for highlighting but this is incorrect and CoinDCX wallets are not breached. Pls don’t spread rumours.

The addresses tagged by Arkham used to belong to CoinDCX before the last year hack ie July 2025. These addresses were generated in Jan 2025 and were compromised in the previous hack in July 2025. The hackers seem to be re-using the old wallet addresses and this sounds like a false alarm. We have checked all the present CoinDCX central and user addresses. None of them have sent money to these old addresses.

All the CoinDCX addresses are public and can be seen on our POR link. None of these have sent funds to the above addresses in question and none of the CoinDCX funds got compromised.

Will keep you posted if any new info comes to us as the team is investigating it further. More details to follow from the official CoinDCX handles soon.

— Sumit Gupta (@smtgpt) October 22, 2026

articles.title: Splitit World Mastercard Offers White-Label Instalment Card to Banks
articles.excerpt:
Splitit has partnered with Mastercard to offer mid-sized banks and credit unions a branded instalment credit card, due for launch in early 2027.

The post Splitit World Mastercard Offers White-Label Instalment Card to Banks appeared first on The Fintech Times .

Splitit has announced the Splitit World Mastercard, a white-label credit card built for mid-sized banks and credit unions that embeds instalment payment functionality into everyday card spending. The product is expected to reach financial institutions in early 2027, built on Mastercard’s network and branded under each issuing institution’s own name. 

The card works through a consumer-set spending threshold configured in the bank’s own mobile app. Purchases below the threshold are settled in full within 30 days, while those above it can be split automatically into fixed monthly payments. Cardholders retain the ability to switch a purchase back to full payment, or to adjust the instalment schedule, before their statement closes. Splitit supplies the instalment engine and an AI-enabled mobile experience that banks embed within their existing digital infrastructure; Mastercard provides the acceptance network, tokenisation, Zero Liability protection and dispute resolution.

 The strategic case for white-label 

 Nandan Sheth, CEO at Splitit 

Chief executive Nandan Sheth framed the product around a structural shift in consumer borrowing preferences: “Banks already have the relationship, the brand and the primary account. What many of them lack is a way to offer instalment plans at the point of purchase without having to build a lending business from scratch. Our white-label card gives them that, under their own name.”

The addressable target, mid-sized banks and credit unions, is a segment that has historically been unable to compete with larger issuers or fintech challengers on instalment credit. Building a proprietary buy-now-pay-later or instalment programme in-house requires significant technology investment, regulatory approval and underwriting infrastructure. A white-label arrangement shifts that burden to Splitit and Mastercard, while allowing the institution to retain the customer relationship and the data that comes with it. That data point is increasingly consequential as card-linked loyalty and personalisation become differentiators in retail banking.

 Market context and regulatory backdrop 

The instalment credit market has become congested since the first wave of standalone buy-now-pay-later providers scaled rapidly after 2019. Regulatory headwinds have followed. In the UK, the Financial Conduct Authority has been moving towards formal regulation of BNPL products after years of consultation, and the EU has brought short-term instalment lending within the scope of the revised Consumer Credit Directive. These developments have nudged the market away from pure BNPL apps towards card-linked and bank-embedded models, which sit within more established regulatory frameworks and carry the credibility of an existing banking relationship.

Splitit’s model is distinct in that it operates against existing credit card lines rather than issuing new credit. The Splitit World Mastercard extends that positioning into a full issuing product, which changes the regulatory relationship: the issuing bank carries the credit risk and compliance obligations, while Splitit provides the technology layer. That division is likely to be attractive to institutions that want the product functionality without assuming the role of a new credit originator.

Competitor pressure comes from several directions. Established card networks have their own instalment overlay products, processors are building instalment APIs, and some larger banks have launched their own proprietary solutions. The key differentiator Splitit is claiming is distribution at the mid-market tier, a segment where the economics of in-house development rarely stack up. Splitit reports around 4,500 active merchants across 30 countries on its existing platform, which gives it both a merchant acceptance footprint and a data asset that could support underwriting and product refinement for issuing partners.

articles.title: 《FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE》Steam同上四萬人峰值超越《FF7重生》 刷新《FF》PC單機作品紀錄
articles.excerpt:
Square Enix 新作角色扮演遊戲《FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE》在 Steam 平台人氣持續攀升。據 SteamDB 統計，在截稿前本作在上市首個週末同上峰值創下正式超越《FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH》保持的 40,564 人，刷新目前《Final Fantasy》系列單機作品在 Steam 平台的紀錄。

Square Enix 新作角色扮演遊戲《FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE》在 Steam 平台人氣持續攀升。據 SteamDB 統計，在截稿前本作在上市首個週末同上峰值創下正式超越《FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH》保持的 40,564 人，刷新目前《Final Fantasy》系列單機作品在 Steam 平台的紀錄。

 

Steam同時接続4万2000人突破すごい！ 世界中で、Steamユーザーの方だけでもこんなに沢山遊んでくれていること、本当にありがたいです！ありがとうございます！ Over 42,000 concurrent players on Steam! Incredible! 🎉 I’m truly grateful to see so many people around the world enjoying FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE — and that’s just on Steam alone! Thank you all so much! 🙏

— 中島啓輔 Nakashima Keisuke (@kesuikemshikana) October 25, 2026 

 

 

 

 

 

《FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE》是《Final Fantasy》系列首款採用 HD-2D 美術風格的作品，由 Square Enix 與 LANCARSE 開發，以手機遊戲《FINAL FANTASY BRAVE EXVIUS》第一章故事為基礎重新打造，並非單純移植，將戰鬥系統以及世界地圖重構加入，並有主線劇情全語音演出。

 

 

 

以騎士雷因與拉斯韋爾、少女非娜的冒險為主軸，加入《岐路旅人》為基礎的回合制戰鬥，並有可克勞德、提達、光之戰士等歷代《FF》角色的「幻兵」系統，融合懷舊像素風格與現代遊戲設計。

《FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE》現已登上 PS5、Nintendo Switch 2、Nintendo Switch、Xbox Series X|S 與 PC 平台，Steam 版本支援繁體中文次日發行。

 

 

 

雖然晚主機版本一天，讓《FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE》於台灣時間 10 月 23 日登上 Steam，但上市首日便以 27,933 人超越《FINAL FANTASY XVI》的 27,508 人，並獲得壓倒性好評。

 

 

 

 

最終在週日超越過去《FF》單機作品 同上紀錄。過去由 2025 年 1 月推出的《FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH》保持，當時雖並非同步發行，但在上市首週達到 40,564 人同時遊玩。如今《FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE》超越紀錄，目前為系列在 Steam 表現最突出的單機作品，紀錄隨著明年《FINAL FANTASY VII Revelation》上市可望將再被打破，也顯見 Square Enix 逐漸將 Steam 視為重要發行平台的跡象。

 

 

 

另外，參與《FINAL FANTASY BRAVE EXVIUS》10 年間劇本創作的北島行德，也在《FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE》上市前夕透過個人 X 帳號發表感言。表示自己至今寫過無數劇本、創造許多角色，但其中雷因、拉斯韋爾與菲娜對他而言是格外重要且特別的存在。如今能再次將角色的全新故事帶給玩家，讓他感到非常開心與感激，他同時也同步追蹤到了本作突破 4 萬同上的瞬間。

articles.title: 手游《蔚蓝档案》日服运营商变更：Yostar 将于 2027 年 1 月移交业务给 NEXON
articles.excerpt:
IT之家 10 月 25 日消息，韩国 NEXON Games 旗下手游《蔚蓝档案》日服运营商 Yostar 今日在官方直播中宣布，计划于 2027 年 1 月左右将日本地区的游戏运营业务全面移交给 NEXON，结束自游戏 2021 年上线以来持续近六年的代理合作关系。

Yostar 代表取缔役社长李衡达表示，Yostar 与《蔚蓝档案》开发商 NEXON Games 经过长时间协商后，最终达成共识，决定终止现有发行合约，并将日本地区的运营业务移交给 NEXON。

 

 

针对玩家最关心的游戏数据问题，李衡达强调，即使发行商发生变更，《蔚蓝档案》日服仍将继续运营。Yostar 也将尽力确保玩家持有的游戏道具、尚未使用的青辉石及其他游戏数据能够完整继承，让玩家在运营移交后继续正常游玩。

至于现有游戏数据的具体处理方式及账号迁移手续等细节，官方表示将于后续另行公布。李衡达也对突然宣布这项重大消息，以及可能给玩家带来的担忧与不安表达歉意。他表示，在正式完成移交之前，Yostar 仍将一如既往地负责《蔚蓝档案》日服的运营，继续提供游戏服务及相关活动。

对于国服，根据“蔚蓝档案”公众号，《蔚蓝档案》简中服将继续由上海星啸网络科技有限公司负责发行与运营。上海星啸网络科技有限公司对简中服承担的运营与服务责任保持不变。

articles.title: 《蔚藍檔案》日版2027年營運將移交NEXON 發行商Yostar宣布結束六年代理合作
articles.excerpt:
韓國 NEXON Games 開發的人氣手機遊戲《蔚藍檔案》日版營運商 Yostar 今日在官方直播中宣布，預計於 2027 年 1 月左右，將日本地區的遊戲營運業務全面移交 NEXON，結束自 2021 年遊戲上市以來持續近六年的代理合作關係。

韓國 NEXON Games 開發的人氣手機遊戲《蔚藍檔案》日版營運商 Yostar 今日在官方直播中宣布，預計於 2027 年 1 月左右，將日本地區的遊戲營運業務全面移交 NEXON，結束自 2021 年遊戲上市以來持續近六年的代理合作關係。

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

消息由 Yostar 代表取締役社長李衡達親自透過直播節目尾聲宣布。他表示 Yostar 與《蔚藍檔案》開發商 NEXON Games 經過長時間協商，最終雙方達成共識，決定終止現有的發行合約，並將日本地區的營運業務移交 NEXON。

 

 

 

發行商變更預計於 2027 年 1 月左右實施，而當月下旬預定進行的遊戲更新及「ブルアカふぇす！」活動，則將由 NEXON 的營運體制負責。實際移交日期仍有待後續公告。

 

 

 

針對玩家最關心的遊戲資料問題，李衡達強調，即使發行商變更，《蔚藍檔案》日本地區的服務仍將繼續。Yostar 也將致力於確保玩家持有的遊戲道具、尚未使用的青輝石及其他遊戲資料能夠完整繼承，讓玩家在營運移交後繼續遊玩。

 

 

 

至於現有遊戲資料的處理方式，以及帳號移轉手續等細節，官方表示將於後續另行公布。李衡達也對突然宣布這項重大消息，以及可能造成玩家擔憂與不安表達歉意。他表示，在正式移交之前，Yostar 仍將一如既往地負責《蔚藍檔案》日本地區的營運，持續提供遊戲服務及相關活動。

 

 

 

 

 

他提到包括今日直播發表的新活動，以及即將舉行的「帰ってきた！ブルアカVR！＋」等企劃，都將持續推進，希望玩家不要只是等待發行商變更的日子到來，而是能繼續享受《蔚藍檔案》的遊戲內容。

 

 

 

《蔚藍檔案》由韓國 NEXON Games 開發，2021 年 2 月 4 日率先於日本推出，由 Yostar 負責當地發行營運及周邊單曲商品、短影片、ASMR 等眾多企劃，甚至在秋葉原 JR 車站開啟了官方商店。繼國際版由 NEXON 主導後，此次移交完成讓日本版也將轉為由 NEXON 直接營運。

 

 

 

對於此次合作關係告一段落，Yostar 並未進一步說明終止發行合約的具體原因，僅表示這是雙方經過長時間協商後共同做出的決定。李衡達最後再次感謝玩家長期以來的支持。

 

另一方面，《蔚藍檔案》遊戲總監金用河也發表公開信，針對突如其來的營運商變更向玩家致歉。他表示，這項決定是雙方經過長時間思考與協商後，為了讓《蔚藍檔案》能夠更長久、穩定且持續深化發展而做出的選擇。

 

 

 

金用河也特別向 Yostar 社長李衡達及相關工作人員表達感謝，坦言自己不僅身為開發者，也身為一名玩家，深切感受到 Yostar 對作品與玩家投入的熱情。他表示，今後開發團隊將承擔起雙方多年來共同累積的成果，並希望未來仍能與 Yostar 維持良好關係。

 

針對未來營運，金用河強調，雖然負責公司將有所改變，但開發團隊仍會持續推進故事、遊戲內容及服務，並與 Yostar 密切合作，確保玩家長期累積的遊戲紀錄與回憶能順利繼承。至於這次決策的詳細經過與未來發展方向，他預告將於近期與李衡達共同向玩家說明。
